kyoto_yakiniku_tsumugi.gf_detail: Ask. Wagyu yakiniku with salt or sauce, strip loin grilled sukiyaki-style and dipped in egg yolk, kimchi and namul; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_tsumugi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku house; the only sides in the course are kimchi and bean-sprout namul (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_tsumugi.hours_raw: 15:00–23:00, every day (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closing days may vary (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, though walk-ins are welcomed; full by 17:00 on a September 2026 evening, so booking is wise (Tabelog; September 2026). 10% service charge (Tabelog). 18 table seats on high chairs around drum-can grills; can be hired for up to 50 (Tabelog; October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay (Tabelog). By the Takase River on Nishi-Kiyamachi south of Sanjo; 3 min walk from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; September 2026).
kyoto_yakiniku_tsumugi.notes: [Yakiniku · Kiyamachi, wagyu courses round a drum can] A casual yakiniku room by the Takase River where you sit on high chairs round drum-can grills and work through small portions of wagyu: three kinds of tongue, outside skirt, chateaubriand, kalbi with salt and with sauce, and a strip-loin slice grilled sukiyaki-style and dipped in egg yolk — 120 g for ¥4,400, or 180 g for ¥5,500, plus 10% service. Cheerful staff explain the cuts. Open from 15:00; book for evenings.

roles: Staff (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: high-quality meat at prices as accessible as possible, small portions of wagyu like sushi, "satisfaction beyond the price" in Kiyamachi. October 2026 reviewers describe cheerful staff who explain each cut and a mix of tourists and locals.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the Tabelog shop text: "satisfaction beyond the price".
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu course with chateaubriand; strip loin with egg yolk.

anecdotes.text: "The style of grilling around the drum can was refreshing, creating a different atmosphere from the usual yakiniku." — September 2026.
"The meat portion is 120g per person, which might be just right for women! For men, it might feel a bit insufficient." — October 2026.
"The cheerful and energetic staff provided explanations about the meat, making the dining experience enjoyable." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 焼肉・ホルモン、中京区北車屋町272-1、京阪三条駅から徒歩3分、毎日15:00〜23:00 (L.O. 料理22:00・ドリンク22:30)、不定休、予約可、サービス料10%、18席 (テーブル)、貸切50名まで、カード・PayPay・d払い・楽天ペイ・au PAY・Alipay 可、和牛コース120g 4,400円 (牛タン3種、シャトーブリアン、ハラミ、ロースの焼きすき)、特選和牛コース180g 5,500円、店舗紹介: 寿司のように少量ずつ味わう和牛、値段以上の満足。口コミ (2026年9〜10月、英語): ドラム缶を囲む焼肉、ハイチェア、キムチ盛り合わせ、もやしナムル、上カルビ (塩・たれ)、卵黄のロース、ライス330円、Kyoto Beer Matcha 990円、梅酒ソーダ770円、明るいスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Fixed courses; staff explain the cuts; 10% service; cards and QR accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (staff-maintained); reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_kawa_cafe.gf_detail: Ask. Quiche, galettes, pasta, pizza, sandwiches, crêpes and tarts by day, bistro dishes at night; no gluten information (official site; October 2026).
kyoto_kawa_cafe.vegan_detail: Ask. French bistro and café menu with cakes and tarts; no vegan dish is named (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_kawa_cafe.hours_raw: Tabelog: 10:00–23:30 every day, closed irregularly. The official site gives 10:00 to midnight in Japanese and 10:00–23:00 in English and French, "non-stop". No reservations (Tabelog); private hire for groups (official site). The riverside terrace (kawayuka) runs only in season, until September, with a ¥300 seat charge (July–October 2026). Cash only (Tabelog). 20 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Many guests and staff are from abroad (2026 reviews). On Kiyamachi north of Matsubara, backing onto the Kamo River; 8 min walk from Kawaramachi, Gion-Shijo and Kiyomizu-Gojo stations (Tabelog). Open since 2012 (official site).
kyoto_kawa_cafe.notes: [Café · Kiyamachi, a machiya on the Kamo River] An all-day café-bistro in an old townhouse whose big back windows — and, until September, a riverside terrace — look straight onto the Kamo River and the herons on its banks. French-leaning food from galettes and quiche at lunch to bistro plates and wine at night, with cakes, chai and cocktails between; the house cat Kawa-chan naps in a basket. Many staff and guests are from abroad. Service draws mixed reviews in 2026 — slow, orders misunderstood, a ¥300 terrace charge. Cash only.

roles: Owner and staff (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (in Japanese, English and French): Kawa Café, since 2012, in a machiya facing the Kamogawa, offers non-stop service from breakfast to bar, French bistro food, sweets and Japanese dishes "at very friendly prices", and aims to preserve Kyoto’s architectural heritage and save water and energy. Reviewers in 2026 describe staff mostly from abroad and a resident cat, Kawa-chan, the cat on the shop sign.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: Kyoto heritage preserved, water and energy saved, "an eco-friendly perspective".
chef_bio.specialty: Tarts; galettes; drinks on the river.

anecdotes.text: "Kawa-chan was wandering around the cafe and napping in a basket, looking incredibly cute!" — June 2026.
"There was a white heron on the opposite bank, and I leisurely enjoyed a relaxing afternoon." — June 2026.
A July 2026 visitor paid a ¥300 terrace charge, found the chairs worn, had to repeat an order for iced chai several times, received no water, and felt ¥700 for a weak chai was too much.
A May 2026 visitor found both staff members on duty unfriendly.
An October 2026 visitor was served an iced drink instead of a hot one and found the wanted cake sold out.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kawa-cafe.com、日本語・英語・フランス語): Since 2012、鴨川に面した京町家、床シーズンにはテラス席、朝食、ブランチ、ランチ、スイーツとお茶、夕食前の一杯、ディナー、バータイムまでノンストップ営業、フランスのビストロ料理、スイーツ、和食、営業時間は毎日朝10時から夜24時まで (英語・仏語では23時まで)、個室貸し切り、京都の建築遺産と資源の保全。食べログ: カフェ・ビストロ・バー、下京区木屋町通松原上ル美濃屋町176-1、毎日10:00〜23:30、不定休、予約不可、20席、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、禁煙。口コミ (2026年5〜10月、英語): 看板猫の Kawa-chan、鴨川の眺め、テラス席は9月まで・席料300円、洋梨のタルト950円、アイスチャイ700円、シャンディガフ900円、キッシュ、ガレット、パスタ、ピザ、ラーメン、海外のスタッフ、接客への不満。

cultural_comfort.note: Trilingual website; many staff from abroad; cash only; terrace seat charge in season.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_nihon_ryori_sakuragawa.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the restaurant states on Tabelog, "We do not accept reservations for vegetarians or those with gluten allergies," and may decline other dietary restrictions (Tabelog, staff-maintained).
kyoto_nihon_ryori_sakuragawa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the restaurant does not accept reservations for vegetarians (Tabelog); the kaiseki is built on fish, freshly shaved katsuobushi dashi and seasonal seafood (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_nihon_ryori_sakuragawa.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00, dinner 18:00–22:00; closed Sunday and over New Year (official site; Tabelog). Lunch course at ¥16,500 must be booked by the day before (official site). Cancellations: 50% the day before, 100% on the day; tell the shop if more than 15 minutes late — after 30 minutes the booking may be cancelled (Tabelog). 10% service charge at lunch and dinner (official site). No vegetarians or gluten-allergic guests; other dietary restrictions may be declined (Tabelog). Counter seats from middle-school age, ordering the adult course (Tabelog). 14 seats: a 10-seat white-wood counter and a semi-private table for 2–4; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible (official site; Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). On Kiyamachi south of Nijo by the Takase River; 3 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_nihon_ryori_sakuragawa.notes: [Kaiseki · Kiyamachi Nijo, a white-wood counter by the Takase River] A quiet kaiseki restaurant by the Takase River with a 10-seat white-wood counter, where the cooks use freshly shaved katsuobushi and build seasonal courses — hamo shabu-shabu in summer, matsutake and hamo in autumn, clay-pot rice with eel to finish. Lunch from ¥8,800, dinner ¥22,000–27,500, plus 10% service. Note: the house does not take bookings from vegetarians or guests with gluten allergies. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner and cooks (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Japanese cooking that respects tradition while offering Sakuragawa’s own taste, katsuobushi shaved fresh, fifteen to twenty sakes and wines on hand, sake vessels made by artists, and dishes suited to each guest’s tastes; a branch, おばんざい櫻川, closed in February 2026. A September 2026 reviewer says the restaurant has earned a Michelin star; an eighteen-time regular describes the counter full of locals (September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: no corner cut, from buying to cooking to serving.
chef_bio.specialty: Hamo and matsutake; clay-pot rice; pudding.

anecdotes.text: An 18th-visit regular in September 2026 had hamo from Awaji and Korea and matsutake from Iwate in a dobin-mushi, a fried dish, a grilled wrap, sashimi and clay-pot rice, and took the leftover rice home.
"This was the best kombu-kelp marinated dish I’ve ever had." — September 2026.
"If I had to wish for something more, I would have liked to have one additional dish... It might be a bit insufficient in quantity for men." — November 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoto-sakuragawa.jp): 京都・木屋町の日本料理、白木のカウンター十席と半個室のテーブル一卓、昼12:00〜14:00・夜18:00〜22:00、昼夜ともサービス料10%、日曜定休、年末年始休み、削りたての鰹節、常時15〜20種の日本酒とワイン、作家の酒器、夜の会席22,000円・27,500円 (税込)、夜は一品料理も、昼の会席8,800円・16,500円 (前日までの要予約)、季節の例 (鱧しゃぶ玉葱風味だし、秋茄子と落鮎のステーキ ほか)、佃煮・鍋セット・ポン酢の通販、おせち、支店おばんざい櫻川は2026年2月に閉店。食べログ (店舗会員): ベジタリアンとグルテンアレルギーの方の予約は不可、その他の食事制限もお断りする場合あり、カウンターは中学生以上、キャンセル料 (前日50%、当日100%)、14席、禁煙、車椅子可、カード可。口コミ (2026年5〜11月、英語): 昼の会席16,500円+サービス料、鱧しゃぶ、松茸、昆布締めの鯛、土鍋ご飯、プリン、ミシュランの星。

cultural_comfort.note: English page on the official site; book ahead (TableCheck); no vegetarian or gluten-allergy bookings.

staff_allergy_handling: Declines reservations from vegetarians and guests with gluten allergies; may decline other dietary restrictions (Tabelog, staff-maintained).

existence.note: Official site (September 2026 notices) and Tabelog listing (staff-maintained); reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_nihon_ryori_sakuragawa.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260202/26000659/ (35.012176, 135.770684), moved ~4 m north to stay 5.7 m from kyoto_kappou_yamashita (491-3, same lot); GSI matches only the town 京都府京都市中京区上樵木町 for 491, 491-3 and 492 (72 m), so the pin rests on the Tabelog point (GSI only, no OSM); 2026-11-05

kyoto_coppie.gf_detail: Ask. Genre-free plates include spring rolls, shumai, noodles, risotto and curry alongside sashimi and grilled fish and game; the shop asks to be told of allergies and dietary restrictions in advance (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_coppie.vegan_detail: Ask. The menu is built on fish, game and meat, but the shop invites guests to state dietary restrictions in advance (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_coppie.hours_raw: From 17:00 to 24:30, last food order 21:30; closed irregularly — see Instagram (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; tell the shop in advance about allergies, restrictions or a stay under two hours; no strong perfume (Tabelog). Children under 9 only at one table, arranged in advance; children’s meals on request (Tabelog). 20 seats: 12 at the counter and 8 at tables; non-smoking, with a smoking spot outside (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Sommelier; bring-your-own possible (Tabelog). In a townhouse with a courtyard on Takatsuji; 10 min walk from Shijo-Omiya, about 10 min by taxi from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog; June 2026). Opened 12 August 2021 (Tabelog).
kyoto_coppie.notes: [Creative · Shijo Omiya, a genre-free townhouse counter] A stylish machiya counter with a courtyard, a short walk off the beaten track south-west of Shijo Omiya, cooking genre-free small plates from ingredients all over Japan — Kamo eggplant with mole and passion fruit, conger and gorgonzola spring rolls, Ezo venison — mostly à la carte, with clever wine, sake and alcohol-free pairings. Staff are friendly and full of stories. Bills run about ¥10,000–30,000. A March 2026 regular felt the mood changed with many overseas guests. Open from 17:00; closed irregularly (Instagram).

roles: Chef and staff (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Opened 12 August 2021 (Tabelog); reviewers celebrated its fifth anniversary in August 2026 with a special course. 2026 reviewers describe friendly, knowledgeable staff, drink pairings full of surprises, and an alcohol-free list of "craft winy" mocktails. A March 2026 regular found the visit disappointing, suggesting that about half the guests being foreigners had changed the atmosphere.
chef_bio.specialty: Genre-free small plates; drink pairings.

anecdotes.text: "For the noodle dish, I had it topped with karasumi (dried mullet roe) made when the restaurant first opened" — August 2026.
"What stood out this time was the impressive selection of non-alcoholic drinks." — August 2026.
"This time was a bit disappointing. Perhaps it’s because about half of the customers were foreigners, which changed the atmosphere?" — March 2026.
"The à la carte dishes were excellent, but what truly stood out was the wine and drink pairings, which were filled with surprises and excitement." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 創作料理・イノベーティブ、下京区高辻猪熊町367、阪急四条大宮駅から徒歩10分、17:00〜24:30 (料理 L.O. 21:30)、不定休 (Instagram)、予約可 (アレルギーや苦手なもの、2時間未満の滞在は事前に連絡、香水は控える)、9歳未満は1卓のみ・事前連絡、子供の料理は予約時に相談、20席 (カウンター12、テーブル8)、禁煙 (屋外に喫煙所)、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、ソムリエ、持ち込み可、2021年8月12日オープン。口コミ (2026年3〜10月、英語): ジャンルレスのアラカルト、Shimane の鯵、賀茂茄子のモーレ、穴子とゴルゴンゾーラの春巻き、甘鯛の炭火焼き、Ezo 鹿、5周年の特別コース15,000円、開店時のカラスミ、ノンアルコールのペアリング、自家製ジンジャーエール、中庭、海外の客が多いとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead and mention allergies; à la carte at the counter; cards accepted.

kyoto_musoushin_gion.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: homemade wheat noodles in a chicken-and-pork-bone soup; tsukemen and mazesoba also wheat (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_musoushin_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the broth is chicken and pork bone with vegetables, topped with chashu (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_musoushin_gion.hours_raw: 11:30–24:00 (last order 23:30), every day (Tabelog). Order by ticket machine (September 2026). 15 seats: 11 at the counter and a table for four; non-smoking; no cards (Tabelog). On Yamato-oji south of Shijo, near Kenninji; 238 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; March 2025).
kyoto_musoushin_gion.notes: [Ramen · Gion, near Kenninji] A late-opening Gion branch of a Kameoka ramen shop, with a creamy chicken-and-pork-bone soup thickened with eight vegetables, homemade flat noodles and tender chashu (Musou Shin ramen ¥1,200); also black-sesame ramen, tsukemen and a mentaiko mazesoba. Busy with overseas visitors; reviewers born in Kyoto are mixed. Ticket machine; open 11:30 to midnight daily.

roles: Operator unnamed in the sources
chef_bio.background: Opened 2 July 2014 (Tabelog). Per the operator’s Tabelog text: Kameoka’s veggie-potage ramen brought to Gion. Reviews mention a Kameoka shop (September 2024) and a Toronto shop listed in the Michelin Guide, which the Gion shop advertises on a sign (August 2025, September 2026). The shop website listed on Tabelog returned 403 on 2026-11-05.
chef_bio.specialty: Musou Shin ramen; black sesame ramen.

anecdotes.text: A Kyoto-born August 2025 diner noticed long lines of foreign customers at night and found the ramen "somewhat difficult to understand".
An April 2026 regular-of-old found prices up, the ¥10 extra-noodle option gone and the portion seemingly smaller.
A September 2024 reviewer found the broth lacking umami and the service poor.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 無双心 祇園店、ラーメン・つけ麺・食堂、東山区大和大路四条下ル小松町558-2、祇園四条駅から238m、毎日 11:30〜24:00 (L.O. 23:30)、予約可、15席 (カウンター11、4人掛けテーブル1)、禁煙、カード不可、2014年7月2日オープン、亀岡の veggie pota ラーメン、香味野菜8種の鶏豚骨スープ、自家製平打ち麺、やわらかいチャーシュー、Maeda Kaisen の明太子のまぜそば、Thai-style の一杯。口コミ (2024年9月〜2026年9月、英語): 無双心ラーメン1,200円、黒ごまラーメン、味玉つけ麺、とんこつラーメン、券売機、海外からの客が多い、トロント店がミシュランガイド掲載、亀岡店。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine at the door; cash only.

kyoto_arata_okonomiyaki.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: okonomiyaki batter, yakisoba and udon, with sweet-spicy sauces (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_arata_okonomiyaki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the menu is beef tendon, offal, pork and egg on the teppan (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_arata_okonomiyaki.hours_raw: 17:00–21:45, Monday to Saturday; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Bookings advised — full from opening even on weekdays; 90-minute seating (Tabelog; October 2026). Cash only (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). 50 seats incl. counter and tatami, with a busy second floor up the stairs; non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2026). 6 min from the Hachijo exit of JR Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
kyoto_arata_okonomiyaki.notes: [Okonomiyaki & horumon · south of Kyoto Station] A lively, Showa-feeling okonomiyaki house near the Hachijo exit, packed from its 17:00 opening: the famous Arata-yaki loaded with agi beef tendon and Kujo onion, salt-grilled offal, yakisoba with a fiery house sauce, and the sweet 'Bakudan' (port wine and soda) to drink. Book ahead; 90-minute tables; cash only. Okonomiyaki Tabelog 100 2018–2025. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner (unnamed; quoted in the operator’s Tabelog text)
chef_bio.background: Per the operator’s Tabelog text: a charming okonomiyaki shop with a wide range of horumon dishes; "agi" is the sinewy meat from the jaw, a different cut from the one in the yakisoba, per the owner. Tabelog Okonomiyaki "Tabelog 100" 2018, 2019, 2022–2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Arata-yaki; agi yakisoba.

anecdotes.text: With a 17:00 booking, a party of five found the place already full at opening — October 2026.
Three adults without alcohol paid ¥17,100; the gizzard and chicken neck were over-peppered and the seats tight — September 2026.
An October 2026 reviewer counted American families among the guests.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: あらた、お好み焼き・鉄板焼き、南区西九条院町24-4、JR京都駅八条口から徒歩6分、月〜土 17:00〜21:45、日曜休み、予約可、50席、座敷、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、お好み焼き百名店 2018・2019・2022〜2025、ホルモン料理が豊富、agi 入りのあらたお好み焼き900円、agi 入り焼きそば1,510円、自家製の辛いソース、"Aka" の焼酎割り420円 (店舗紹介文)。口コミ (2026年9〜10月、英語): あらた焼き、ホルモンミックス、hoso の塩焼き、ミノ、Mambo-yaki、Danjiri-yaki、ガーリックライス、Bakudan、90分制、現金のみ、満席。

kyoto_kanesho_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled eel with a soy-based tare over rice, liver in sauce, rolled omelette and clear soup; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kanesho_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an eel restaurant; the rice bowls also carry egg (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kanesho_gion.hours_raw: 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed Thursday and Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations for dinner only (Tabelog); a wait at weekend lunches (July 2026). Lunch serves the rice dishes only; omakase and side dishes such as liver and the eel omelette in the evening (January, October 2026). Eel is grilled to order, about 20 minutes (September 2026). 14 seats (6 counter, 8 table); non-smoking; cash only; no service charge (Tabelog). At the end of a back alley off Yamatooji north of Shijo — the entrance is hard to find; 3 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_kanesho_gion.notes: [Unagi · Gion, the kinshi-don's home in a back alley] A small eel house at the end of an alley off Yamatooji, said by reviewers to date from 1866 and to have created the kinshi-don: eel tucked under a mound of fine shredded omelette on rice mixed with sesame and sauce (¥2,700, September 2026). The eel is grilled Kansai-style without steaming, to order, so allow about 20 minutes. Unaju and an eel ochazuke with green tea are the other classics; liver and the eel omelette are evening-only. Run by two cooks; cash only; closed Thursday and Sunday; book for dinner.

roles: Two cooks run the shop (September 2026 reviews); unnamed
chef_bio.background: Reviews from January–August 2026 give the founding as 1866 (Keio era) and call it the birthplace of the eel kinshi-don; two 2026 reviewers mention a Michelin Bib Gourmand. A January 2026 reviewer says the eel is mainly domestic, from Mikawa.
chef_bio.specialty: Kinshi-don; Kansai-style unaju.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner, back after 12 years, could not have grilled liver because there was not enough eel that night, and was talked out of ordering both an omelette and a kinshi-don ("too much egg").
"The teapot contained actual tea, not dashi broth." — the eel ochazuke, July 2026.
An October 2026 lunch diner, frustrated by reheated eel elsewhere, found the freshly grilled skin still crisp at the last bite.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: かね正、うなぎ、東山区大和大路通四条上ル2丁目常盤町155-2、祇園四条駅から徒歩3分、11:30〜14:00・17:30〜21:00、木曜・日曜休み、予約は夜のみ、14席 (カウンター6、テーブル8)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、サービス料・チャージなし。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 1866年 (Keio) 創業、きんし丼発祥の店、ミシュランのビブグルマン、蒸さずに焼く関西風、きんし丼2,700円、うな重、まむし丼、お茶漬け (本物のお茶)、夜のおまかせ (肝煮、白焼き、だし巻き、う巻き)、肝吸い、二人で営む、入口がわかりにくい。

cultural_comfort.note: Book for dinner; grilled to order (about 20 minutes); cash only.

kyoto_mumurik.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta and bread alongside carpaccio, grilled meats, ajillo and vegetable plates; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_mumurik.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable dishes appear (sweet-potato fries, mushroom salad, white asparagus), but sauces use egg, butter and cheese and no vegan dish is named (2026 reviews).
kyoto_mumurik.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:30 daily except Tuesday, and no lunch on the 1st, 3rd and 5th Wednesdays; dinner 17:00–22:00 (Friday and Saturday to 22:30), last food order 21:30; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). At dinner at least one drink and one food item each, and no pasta-only orders — come at lunch for pasta alone (Tabelog). Reservations online or by phone; weekends book out (Tabelog; September 2026). Lunch sets A and B, with appetizers, dessert and a drink in B (May, September 2026). 14 seats (8 table, 6 counter); non-smoking; cards and PayPay (Tabelog). Off Nishiki Market on Fuyacho south of Takoyakushi, 5 min from Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; May 2026). Opened 5 December 2011 (Tabelog).
kyoto_mumurik.notes: [Italian · Nishiki, a small wine bar with a big menu] A fourteen-seat Italian on Fuyacho, steps from Nishiki Market, calm and stylish, with a menu so long it is hard to choose: figs with mascarpone and honey, Naruto-kintoki fries, lily bulb, white asparagus with egg-lemon sauce, balsamic spare ribs, carpaccio, then pasta to finish. Staff suggest wines to your taste. At night order at least a drink and a dish — pasta-only diners are asked to come at lunch, when sets with appetizers and dessert are good value. Weekends book out. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner (unnamed; Tabelog lists a corporate invoice number)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 5 December 2011. A July 2026 reviewer has been coming on every Kyoto trip for nearly eight years.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog: the shop welcomes guests who come to enjoy both food and drink, and asks pasta-only diners to come at lunch because seats are few.
chef_bio.specialty: Antipasti; balsamic spare ribs; lily bulb.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 group found the tables booked and the counter full of visitors from abroad, saw several walk-in groups turned away, and was briefly served a neighbour's salad.
A January 2026 diner described the wines wanted and was recommended excellent ones.
A July 2026 regular of nearly eight years recommends the lily bulb above all and likes eating alone early in the evening.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ムムリク (mumurik)、イタリアン・バル、中京区麩屋町蛸薬師下ル梅屋町488 1F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩5分、昼12:00〜14:30、夜17:00〜22:00 (金土22:30まで、L.O. 料理21:30)、火曜休み、第1・3・5水曜はランチ休み、予約可、夜は1ドリンク1フード以上でパスタのみは不可、14席 (テーブル8、カウンター6)、禁煙、カード・PayPay 可、2011年12月5日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 錦市場のそば、前菜の盛り合わせ、レバーパテ、生ハム、いちじくとマスカルポーネ、Naruto-kintoki のフライ、百合根、ホワイトアスパラガス、スペアリブのバルサミコ煮、鯛のカルパッチョ、アヒージョ、パスタ、ランチの A と B のセット、ワインが豊富。

cultural_comfort.note: Book for dinner; one drink and one dish each at night; cards and PayPay.

kyoto_osteria_il_canto_del_maggio.gf_detail: Ask. Tuscan bistecca and grilled meats sit beside crostini, bread and pasta such as pappardelle; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_osteria_il_canto_del_maggio.vegan_detail: Ask. Minestrone and white beans appear, but the menu centres on beef, boar and duck, and no vegan dish is named (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_osteria_il_canto_del_maggio.hours_raw: 18:00–22:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations needed (July 2025); some nights are reservations only (December 2025). Bread and water are charged; still or sparkling (May 2026). 14 seats at four tables; non-smoking; JCB, AMEX and Diners only (Tabelog). Few non-alcoholic choices (May 2026). On Sakaimachi south of Takoyakushi, 7 min from Karasuma or Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 27 April 2011 (Tabelog).
kyoto_osteria_il_canto_del_maggio.notes: [Italian · Sakaimachi, a Tuscan osteria for bistecca] A small four-table osteria south of Takoyakushi that cooks Tuscany without fuss: crostini, minestrone, wild-boar pappardelle, peposo and, above all, the bistecca alla fiorentina, lean and rare, sold from 500 g off the bone or 1 kg on it — bring friends, though the kitchen has cut smaller. Classic LPs line the room and the chef will put one on. Bread and water are charged; wine-led, with few soft drinks. Book ahead; dinner only, closed Wednesday and Thursday.

roles: Chef (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 27 April 2011; a June 2026 reviewer calls it about 15 years old. Tabelog Italian WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021.
chef_bio.specialty: Bistecca alla fiorentina; wild boar pappardelle.

anecdotes.text: An October 2024 diner talked music with the chef among shelves of classic LPs, and the chef played the record requested.
A July 2025 diner who could not manage the listed 1 kg was offered a smaller bistecca and finished 800 g with a Brunello.
A May 2026 diner noted that bread and water are charged and that the only alcohol-free choice was non-alcoholic beer.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: オステリア・イル・カント・デル・マッジョ、イタリアン、中京区堺町通蛸薬師下ル菊屋町512-2、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩約7分、月火金土日 18:00〜22:00、水木休み、予約可、14席 (2人テーブル1、4人テーブル3)、禁煙、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)、ワインにこだわり、2011年4月27日オープン、イタリアン WEST 百名店 2021。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): トスカーナ料理、ビステッカ (骨付き1kg、骨なし500gから)、牛フィレ150gから、クロスティーニ、ミネストローネ、猪のパッパルデッレ、ペポーゾ、りんごのタルト、パンと水は有料、クラシックのレコード。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; bread and water charged; cards JCB, AMEX and Diners only.

kyoto_mankamerou.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki with soy- and miso-based seasonings, fu, udon or somen and sweets; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_mankamerou.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the courses run on dashi and fish, with eel, crab and beef (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_mankamerou.hours_raw: Tabelog: 12:00–22:00 daily, irregular closures. The official site gives closing days as every Wednesday and the 1st and 4th Tuesdays (may change with bookings), and closes 26 December–5 January. Reservations taken, also online through Pocket Concierge; the phone can be hard to reach during service (Tabelog). About 20% is added for service and taxes (Tabelog). 60 seats in private tatami rooms for 2–6 and larger rooms, with a garden (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Cards, e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). Parking for 5 cars behind the building (Tabelog; official site). Inokuma-dori north of Demizu in Nishijin: 3 min from the Horikawa-Shimochojamachi bus stop, about 20 min on foot from Nijojo-mae or Marutamachi Stn (official site).
kyoto_mankamerou.notes: [Kaiseki · Nishijin, a 300-year-old ryotei of court cuisine] A ryotei on Inokuma-dori in Nishijin that began in 1722 as a sake brewery, 萬屋, and later became the restaurant 萬亀楼; it formally carries on the Imperial Court's Ikama-ryu ceremonial knife school and yusoku-ryori, and the present head is the tenth generation. Meals are served in private tatami rooms over a garden: seasonal courses with hamo and live-grilled ayu in summer, crab and karasumi in winter, and a kago bento at lunch. Courses run about ¥30,000–40,000 a head with about 20% added; at events there may be shikibocho and maiko. Book ahead.

roles: The tenth-generation head of the house (official site; not named)
Proprietress (March 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in Kyoho 7 (1722) as the sake brewery 萬屋 in a corner of Kyoto's Nishijin, later renamed 萬亀楼 as a restaurant; it formally carries on the Ikama-ryu shikibocho and yusoku-ryori connected with the Imperial Palace; the present head is the tenth generation; the house values sincerity, wisdom and humility (「堅実・賢明・謙虚」). Reviewers give its age as 300 years (January, March 2026) or 400 years (December 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: hospitality first — 「おもてなしの心を第一に」.
chef_bio.specialty: Yusoku-ryori; seasonal kaiseki; Ikama-ryu shikibocho.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 party, after a small-drum recital, watched a ceremonial knife performance before dinner and was joined later by maiko and geiko.
A June 2026 diner timed the visit for the Gion Festival season and saw live ayu grilled in the room, with hamo in soup and as sashimi.
An October 2025 reviewer found the cooking prized purity, beauty and the seasons over bold flavour, served in a quiet tatami room with flowers.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (mankamerou.com): 享保七年 (1722年) 創業、京都西陣の一角で造り酒屋「萬屋」として営みを始め、のちに料理屋として「萬亀楼」と改める、御所ゆかりの生間流式庖丁・有職料理を正式に継承、当代は十代目、「堅実・賢明・謙虚」、上京区猪熊通り出水上ル蛭子町387、定休日は毎週水曜日と第1・第4火曜日、12月26日〜1月5日休み、駐車場5台、市バス堀川下長者町から徒歩3分。食べログ: 日本料理・弁当、上京区猪熊通出水上ル、12:00〜22:00、不定休、予約可 (ポケットコンシェルジュ)、サービス料と税で約20%、60席、個室、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 有職料理、個室の座敷と庭、鱧の吸い物、鮎の焼き物、鯛茶漬け、八寸、かご弁当、女将のもてなし、式包丁と舞妓。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (Pocket Concierge online); private tatami rooms; about 20% service and tax added.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_napule_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog’s feature list ticks gluten-free options, but no gluten-free dish is described; the menu is wheat pizza, pasta, gnocchi and fritto (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_napule_gion.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog’s feature list ticks vegan and vegetarian options, but no vegan dish is described; most pizzas carry mozzarella, ricotta or pork (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_napule_gion.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00), dinner 17:30–22:30 (last orders food 21:30, drinks 22:00); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Seat-only reservations, 120 minutes (last order at 90), no seat requests (Tabelog); walk-ins welcomed when space allows (December 2025), a queue at night (October 2026). 10% service charge at dinner (from 2 June 2025, Tabelog). Tabelog also ticks halal options; not verified. 40 seats with counter and sofas; non-smoking; cards, IC cards, e-money and QR payments; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). On Kawabata-dori north of Shijo, by the Kamo River; 3 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_napule_gion.notes: [Pizzeria · Gion, Neapolitan pizza by the Kamo River] The Kyoto branch of Tokyo's Napule, a bright, busy room on Kawabata-dori where pizzas come out of a wood-fired oven built in Naples. Reviewers single out the Chicory — cheese, spinach, onion and bacon — along with a classic Margherita and a honey-drizzled Quattro Formaggi, plus seasonal vegetable fritto and a good panna cotta. Lively and full of visitors from abroad; one May 2026 diner found it too busy to relax. Dinner adds 10% service. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Restaurant of the TERRAMIA group (no chef named)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): the fourth Napule after Minami Aoyama, Tokyo Midtown and Yokohama, baking Neapolitan pizza in a Stefano Ferrara wood-fired oven imported from Naples and using ingredients from Italian producers; Italians living in Japan are said to praise it. Run by a company (a corporate invoice registrant, Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 note many visitors from Europe, America and elsewhere, and some foreign staff whose Japanese was limited (May 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Neapolitan pizza; seasonal fritto.

anecdotes.text: "You, who are reading this review! Think only about eating the pizza called "Chicory" right now!" — December 2025.
A January 2026 diner who came for the decorated surprise plate seen on the official account received a plain plate instead and was disappointed.
A May 2026 diner found the room too crowded with foreign visitors to relax and was told some dishes would take a long time.
An October 2026 lunch for one came to just under ¥9,000 with four desserts and coffee to share; the diner wished lunch desserts and coffee were cheaper.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン、東山区川端通四条上る弁財天町4-4 1F、祇園四条駅から徒歩3分、11:30〜14:30 (L.O. 14:00)・17:30〜22:30 (L.O. 料理21:30、ドリンク22:00)、水曜休み、席のみの予約 (120分制、L.O. は90分、席の指定不可)、ディナーのみサービス料10% (2025年6月2日〜)、40席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン・グルテンフリー・ハラールの対応ありと掲載、南青山・東京ミッドタウン・横浜に続く4店目、ナポリから輸入した Stefano Ferrara の薪窯。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): Chicory、マルゲリータ、クアトロ・フォルマッジと蜂蜜、季節の野菜のフリット、カルパッチョ、リゾット、レモンクリームのニョッキ、ボロネーゼ、パンナコッタ、海外の客が多い、サプライズプレートへの不満。

cultural_comfort.note: Many international guests and some non-Japanese staff (2026 reviews); cards and QR accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the shop (maintenance closure 27–28 October noted); reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_sushi_taizo.gf_detail: Ask. Edomae sushi courses with soy sauce, simmered octopus and chawanmushi; no gluten information (2016–25 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_taizo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sushi and seafood courses (2016–25 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_taizo.hours_raw: Dinner 18:00–21:00 (last order 20:30) Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday; Saturday, Sunday and holidays also lunch 12:00–14:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; a 2023 diner was allowed to bring a baby after asking ahead. 8 counter seats, with a counter in a private room for 4 (Tabelog; January 2022). Non-smoking, with a smoking spot outside; cards (Tabelog). On the Takase River near Kiyamachi and Matsubara, 2 min from the Kawaramachi-Matsubara bus stop, about 10 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; 2022–25 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_taizo.notes: [Sushi · Kiyamachi-Matsubara, a quiet counter on the Takase] An 8-seat sushi counter on the Takase River near Matsubara, plus a little private room with its own counter. Earlier reviews describe a couple running it, a friendly, talkative chef, seasonal Edomae nigiri, homemade karasumi and a good list of unusual sakes; the omakase was ¥15,000 in 2025, with lunch courses on weekends. Book ahead. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per reviews: run by a couple (April 2016), with a friendly head chef and lady of the house (November 2018); in business for over eight years by March 2022; a solo diner in June 2025 enjoyed talking with the friendly chef.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase Edomae sushi.

anecdotes.text: A July 2023 diner booked lunch with a 5-month-old baby after checking with the shop, and thanked staff and other guests for their understanding.
"Since I was traveling alone, I enjoyed engaging conversations with the friendly chef" — June 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司、下京区美濃屋町174-1 プレゼンスビル 1F、河原町松原バス停から徒歩約2分、京都河原町駅から約10分、月火木金 18:00〜21:00 (L.O. 20:30)、土日祝 12:00〜14:00・18:00〜21:00、水曜休み、予約可、カウンター8席、個室カウンター4名、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、カード可。口コミ (2016〜2025年、英語): 夫婦で営む (2016年)、江戸前の寿司、おまかせ15,000円 (2025年6月)、昼のコース約6,000〜7,000円 (2022〜2023年)、毛蟹、ホタルイカ、蛸の煮物、もろこと自家製からすみ、高瀬川沿い、気さくな大将。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; omakase at the counter; the chef chats with guests; cards accepted.

kyoto_izakaya_niefu.gf_detail: Ask. Fried fish with homemade tartar, tempura, salt-fried chicken, simmered dishes and somen; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_izakaya_niefu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood-led izakaya with dashi-based dishes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_izakaya_niefu.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 Tuesday–Saturday; closed Sunday, Monday and on some days in summer and winter (Tabelog). Reservations recommended, also via TableCheck (September 2026); walk-ins sometimes find counter seats late (September 2026). The chef cooks alone, so dishes can take time (July 2026). Portions sized for two, adjusted for three on request (May 2026). 14 seats at an L-shaped counter and two small tables, up a steep wooden staircase; another restaurant is on the ground floor (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). The air conditioning felt weak in July 2026. Non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). A few minutes north of Shijo-Omiya Stn; the sign is easy to miss (2026 reviews).
kyoto_izakaya_niefu.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo-Omiya, a 2nd-floor seafood counter] A 14-seat izakaya up a steep wooden staircase north of Shijo-Omiya — the name, reviewers work out, is '2F'. One chef cooks fresh seafood with care: salt-seared bonito, fried aji or sawara with homemade tartar, young-ayu tempura, simmered whelk, plus salt-fried chicken thighs and a smoked-daikon potato salad, with sake. Most dishes are about ¥1,500 and sized for two. Book ahead; dishes can be slow, and one October 2026 diner found the staff unfriendly. Tuesday–Saturday 17:00–23:00.

roles: Chef who runs the kitchen alone (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: A July 2026 reviewer notes that the chef runs the kitchen alone, so service takes time; reviewers in May and October 2026 take the name to mean "2F", as the shop is on the second floor above another restaurant. Tabelog Izakaya WEST "Tabelog 100" 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Salt-seared bonito; fried fish with homemade tartar; salt-fried chicken.

anecdotes.text: "Since the chef is the only one running the kitchen, it takes quite a while for the dishes to be served, but the quality is definitely worth the wait." — July 2026.
An October 2026 repeat visitor found most dishes ordinary, the value poor and the staff unfriendly, apart from the mehikari.
"Since we visited with three, they kindly adjusted our order from two servings to three." — May 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋、中京区壬生坊城町47 2F、四条大宮駅から343m、火〜土 17:00〜23:00、日・月休み (夏と冬に不定休)、予約可、14席 (カウンターとテーブル)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、居酒屋 WEST 百名店 2026。口コミ (2026年3〜10月、英語): 2階の店で名前は「2F」から、料理人が一人で調理、かつおの塩たたき、刺身盛り合わせ、めひかり、つぶ貝の煮付け、自家製タルタルのあじフライと鰆フライ、稚鮎の天ぷら、鶏ももの塩唐揚げ、燻製大根と長芋のポテサラ、すだちそうめん、じゃこ炒飯、1品約1,500円、提供は遅め、無愛想だったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (TableCheck); dishes come for two; cards and QR accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026; Izakaya WEST Tabelog 100 2026.

kyoto_waguri_senmon_saori.gf_detail: Ask. The Mont Blanc sits on a baked meringue base, but some versions include sponge cake, and tarts and pies are wheat-based; no ingredient lists are published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_waguri_senmon_saori.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chestnut cream with fresh cream and meringue (egg white); fruit parfaits with cream and sorbet (2026 reviews).
kyoto_waguri_senmon_saori.hours_raw: 10:00–18:00 (last order 17:00) daily; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Numbered tickets are handed out from 9:00 (earlier if a queue forms); they set the order, not a time, and you are messaged when your turn comes; takeaway from 11:00 (Tabelog). Reservations online; by phone for one person or for 10 or more; tables are held for one hour and a booking lapses 15 minutes after the time (Tabelog). Some items sell out depending on the time (Tabelog). 34 seats (6 counter, 28 table) including a 2nd floor overlooking the river; non-smoking; cards, IC cards and PayPay (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). On Kiyamachi-dori north of Matsubara by the Takase River; 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_waguri_senmon_saori.notes: [Mont Blanc · Kiyamachi, chestnut threads 1 mm thin] A calm Japanese-chestnut café on Kiyamachi by the Takase River, opened in 2019, where a machine pipes chestnut paste into 1 mm threads at your table. The top Mont Blanc, 'Sa', uses only Kyotanba chestnuts (¥3,080, 40 a day); 'Tsumugi' is a smaller one with a drink (¥1,800), and seasonal parfaits pair the Mont Blanc with grapes or peaches. A sip of dashi resets the palate. Get a numbered ticket from 9:00 or book online. Open daily 10:00–18:00.

roles: Company-run shop (a corporate invoice registrant, Tabelog); no staff named
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): Mont Blanc with chestnut strands as thin as 1 mm, freshly made with carefully selected ingredients, plus seasonal fruit options. A September 2026 reviewer says it opened in October 2019. Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): "Delivering exquisite products filled with the producers’ passion to many people."
chef_bio.specialty: Kinshi Mont Blanc "Sa".

anecdotes.text: "They squeeze chestnut cream right in front of you!" — September 2026.
An October 2026 diner felt that at over ¥3,000 the Mont Blanc ought to taste exceptional, while finding it quite delicious.
"I felt there might be a bit too much meringue inside. I think it could use a bit more cream." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: スイーツ・カフェ・洋菓子、下京区木屋町通松原上る二丁目和泉屋町170-1、京都河原町駅から徒歩5分、毎日10:00〜18:00 (L.O. 17:00)、不定休、整理券は毎朝9:00から配布 (時間指定ではなく順番)、テイクアウトは11:00から、予約可 (1名・10名以上は電話、席は1時間、15分遅れでキャンセル扱い)、34席 (カウンター6、テーブル28)、禁煙、カード・交通系IC・PayPay 可、スイーツ WEST 百名店 2026、1mm の和栗のモンブラン。口コミ (2026年8〜11月、英語): 2019年10月開店、Kyotanba の栗だけの錦糸モンブラン「Sa」3,080円 (1日40食)、「Tsumugi」ドリンク付き1,800円、栗餅1,980円、季節の果物のパフェ、目の前で絞る、口直しの出汁、2階から川の眺め。

cultural_comfort.note: Take a numbered ticket or book online; cards, IC and PayPay accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the shop; reviews dated through November 2026; Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2026.

kyoto_cafe_dong_sfera.gf_detail: Ask. Tarts, pudding and wagashi from Shogetsu are the sweets; no gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_dong_sfera.vegan_detail: Ask. An August 2026 reviewer praised the café’s "commitment to quality vegan food" and the menu offers soy lattes, but the lavender pudding and cheese tart are not vegan; nothing is marked on Tabelog (2026 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_dong_sfera.hours_raw: 12:00–19:00 (last order 18:30); closed Wednesday; hours may change for events — check Instagram (Tabelog). No seat reservations; wagashi from Shogetsu can be reserved by phone for Friday–Sunday (Tabelog; May 2026). No service charge (Tabelog). 30 seats — tables, sunken kotatsu, sofas and a terrace; smoking only on the terrace or outside (Tabelog). Pets allowed inside in a cart or bag (July and October 2026). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). On the semi-basement floor of the Sfera building by the Shirakawa, with galleries and the Sfera shop upstairs; 5 min from Gion-Shijo or Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Formerly named せせらぎ すへら (Tabelog).
kyoto_cafe_dong_sfera.notes: [Café · Shirakawa, a design café with weekend Shogetsu wagashi] A calm, spacious café on the semi-basement floor of the Sfera building, home of the Kyoto homeware brand, near the Shirakawa between Sanjo and Shijo. Seats range from sofas to sunken kotatsu and a terrace, and everything — chairs, cups, plates — is designed. On Friday to Sunday it serves seasonal wagashi from Shogetsu with a drink (¥1,500–1,800; reserve the sweets by phone); otherwise try the organic lavender pudding or the tart of the day. Pets in a carrier welcome. 12:00–19:00, closed Wednesday.

roles: Café of Sfera (homeware brand; official site); no person is named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Sfera designs furniture, tableware and home accessories in natural materials made with traditional hand techniques. Tabelog: formerly せせらぎ すへら; invoice T9130001053604. Tabelog Cafe WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025 (August 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Shogetsu wagashi set (weekends); lavender pudding.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 visitor phoned the same day and was kindly let reserve Shogetsu wagashi, though a day’s notice is usual.
A June 2026 visitor loved the interior and tableware but found the air conditioning weak on a 33 °C day.
An October 2026 visitor arriving on a gloomy Sunday at 13:00 had the room to choose from.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ・甘味処、旧店名 せせらぎ すへら、東山区弁財天町17 スフェラ・ビル、祇園四条駅・三条駅から徒歩約5分、12:00〜19:00 (L.O. 18:30)、水曜休み、イベントで変わる場合は Instagram で、席の予約不可、松月の和菓子は金・土・日のみ電話で予約、サービス料・チャージなし、30席 (テーブル、掘りごたつ、ソファ、テラス)、テラスと店外で喫煙可、カード・PayPay 可、インボイス T9130001053604。公式サイト (ricordi-sfera.com): スフェラのオリジナルの家具、食器、ホームアクセサリー。口コミ (2026年5〜10月、英語): 松月のセット1,500円、Kōgetsu のセット1,800円、オーガニックのラベンダープリン、日替わりのタルト、Kyoto Brewing の Ichigo Ichie 1,200円、ペット可 (カートかバッグ)。

cultural_comfort.note: No bookings for seats; phone ahead for the weekend Shogetsu wagashi.

kyoto_la_mer_giki.gf_detail: Ask when booking — the shop asks for allergies and dislikes at booking (official site). Courses include bread, tarts, sauces and desserts.
kyoto_la_mer_giki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood-led French courses with duck, oysters, beef, lobster and fish (official menu).
kyoto_la_mer_giki.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 13:00) and dinner 18:00–21:30 (last order 19:30); closed Tuesday and irregularly (official site; Tabelog). Phone bookings 9:00–12:00 (Tabelog); the La Mer course can be booked the same day, the bouillabaisse, lobster and special courses two days ahead (official site). 50% charge for same-day cancellations (Tabelog). 12 seats (10 at tables, 2 at the counter), exclusive hire from 9 guests (Tabelog). Cards and QR (Tabelog). An attic room on the 2nd floor west of Kawaramachi-Takatsuji; 5 min from Hankyu Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; February 2025).
kyoto_la_mer_giki.notes: [French · Kawaramachi-Takatsuji, a seafood French in the attic] A twelve-seat attic restaurant west of Kawaramachi-Takatsuji, decorated after the sea of the south of France and of the owner-chef's home, where Shingo Giki cooks French food built on Japanese seafood. The La Mer dinner course (¥6,500) runs from a Kintoki-carrot mousse and a hot-and-cold three-layer soup to a main such as oysters Burgundy-style or duck with honey and mustard; bouillabaisse and lobster courses need two days' notice. Lunch from ¥4,500. Reviewers find it charming and unpretentious; on weekdays the chef's wife may serve. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner (official site: 代表 冝喜 慎吾（ギキ シンゴ）) and chef; the chef’s wife sometimes serves (March 2024)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: La Mer is French for "the sea"; the interior evokes the sea of southern France and the sea of the owner’s home town; the aim is inventive cooking beyond the bounds of French, drawing on Japan’s fresh seafood, for guests including those who come from across the sea. A March 2024 regular notes that the chef usually handles everything and was helped that weekday by the chef’s wife.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to bring out the best in fresh ingredients, especially Japan’s seafood, in cooking full of originality.
chef_bio.specialty: Three-layer soup; oysters Burgundy-style; Kintoki-carrot mousse.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner missed the lobster, unavailable that day, but loved the oysters ordered instead.
A September 2026 diner enjoyed everything but found a few too many sweet dishes.
A February 2026 couple singled out the mushroom sauce on daikon and beef.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (la-mergiki.com): 屋根裏レストラン ラメールギキ、La Mer はフランス語で「海」、店内は南仏の海と故郷の海のイメージ、代表 冝喜 慎吾 (ギキ シンゴ)、下京区茶磨屋町228-2、ランチ12:00〜15:00 (LO 13:00)、ディナー18:00〜21:30 (LO 19:30)、火曜定休 (不定休あり)、ランチ A コース4,500円・B コース5,300円 (税込)、ラメールコース6,500円 (メインは鴨のロースト、カキのブルゴーニュ風、国産牛ホホ肉の赤ワイン煮込み+800円、牛肉のステーキ+1,400円、オマール海老のロースト+1,800円)、ブイヤベースコース6,700円、オマール海老コース9,000円、特別コース11,000円 (2日前までの予約)、苦手な食材・アレルギーは予約時に、2027年のお節料理。食べログ: フレンチ・ビストロ、予約は9時〜12時、当日キャンセルは50%、12席 (テーブル10、カウンター2)、貸切は9名以上、カード・QR 可。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 金時人参のムース、3層のスープ、カキのブルゴーニュ風、モンブラン、平日はシェフの奥さんがサービス。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone (9:00–12:00) or online; special courses two days ahead.

kyoto_saruya_shimogamo.gf_detail: Ask. The 申餅 is a rice-cake sweet with bean paste and the summer ice uses syrups and shiratama; the monaka has a wafer shell; no ingredient list is published (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_saruya_shimogamo.vegan_detail: Ask. The 申餅, bean tea, zenzai and matcha-azuki ice are plant-based in principle, but the strawberry and black-sugar ices come with milk and no ingredient list is published (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_saruya_shimogamo.hours_raw: 10:00–16:30 every day (official site; Tabelog); hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Pay at a ticket machine (November 2026). Summer kakigori is served until about mid-September (August 2026) and can take over 20 minutes in the busy season (August 2026). 60 seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR; paid parking at the shrine; children welcome (Tabelog). Inside the grounds of Shimogamo Shrine; 2 min from the Tadasu-no-mori-mae bus stop, 10 min from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 15 May 2011 (Tabelog).
kyoto_saruya_shimogamo.notes: [Wagashi tea house · Shimogamo Shrine, the revived Aoi Matsuri rice cake] A tea house inside the grounds of Shimogamo Shrine, by the Tadasu-no-mori woods. Its signature is the 申餅, the Aoi Matsuri rice cake coloured a dawn pink with azuki water and revived after some 140 years, served with まめ豆茶, a black-soybean tea that was once the drink of the shrine's priests (¥500). In summer it shaves 'ice of the Kamo ice house' with Hosendo bean paste (¥1,300); in winter, zenzai of Tanba azuki. Pay at the machine; free refills of hojicha. Daily 10:00–16:30.

roles: Shimogamo Shrine rest house (official shrine site); sweets made with Hosendo bean paste per an August 2026 review; no person is named
chef_bio.background: Per the official shrine site: the 申餅, offered to the deities on the Aoi Matsuri day until early Meiji, was revived after 140 years; the black-soybean tea was the drink of shrine priests during purification and is made only from Tanba black soybeans, once from the shrine’s estates; the summer ice is named after the shrine’s old ice house. A November 2026 review says local wagashi artisans revived the 申餅 in 2010 from the shrine’s oral tradition. The background of kyoto_hosen_kyoto_station lists 下鴨神社 さるや among 宝泉’s outlets. Opened 15 May 2011 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official shrine site: eating the 申餅 purifies the body and brings good health, after the old custom.
chef_bio.specialty: 申餅 with まめ豆茶; summer ice; 良縁ぜんざい.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 family waited over 20 minutes for the kakigori in the summer heat.
A September 2026 visitor found the 申餅’s filling "not overly sweet, perfectly seasoned".
An October 2026 visitor noted the free refills of warm hojicha.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 下鴨神社の公式サイト (shimogamo-jinja.or.jp): 休憩処 さるや、下鴨神社境内、10:00〜16:30、「鴨の氷室の氷」(下鴨神社の氷室神事にならった夏のかき氷)、「良縁ぜんざい」(相生社に供えるあずき、最高級の丹波大納言小豆、紅白餅)、冬季メニュー「下鴨神社 まめ豆茶」(神社社領のあった丹波地方の黒豆、潔斎期間中の神官の飲み物)、「申餅」(葵祭りの日に小豆の茹で汁で搗いた御餅、はねず色、140年ぶりに復元)。食べログ: 甘味処・カフェ・和菓子、左京区下鴨泉川町59、糺の森前バス停から徒歩約2分、出町柳駅から徒歩約10分、毎日10:00〜16:30、予約不可、60席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、駐車場あり (有料)、2011年5月15日オープン。口コミ (2026年8〜11月、英語): 申餅とまめ豆茶500円、かき氷1,300円 (Hosendo の丹波大納言のあん)、Aoi Monaka、券売機、ほうじ茶のおかわり。

cultural_comfort.note: Buy a ticket at the machine; free hojicha refills.

existence.note: Official shrine site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_kameya_yoshinaga_honten.gf_detail: Ask. Mostly bean-paste wagashi; a September 2026 reviewer saw new gluten-free products such as a bean-paste spread for bread, while monaka, castella-style An no Hako and baked sweets contain wheat; no full ingredient list was read (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kameya_yoshinaga_honten.vegan_detail: Ask. Ubatama (black-sugar bean-paste balls coated in agar) and many bean-paste sweets are plant-based in principle, but no ingredient list was read; An no Hako combines Western-pastry technique (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kameya_yoshinaga_honten.hours_raw: Shop 9:30–18:00 and tea room 11:00–17:00, every day; closed 1–2 January (Tabelog). The online shop’s phone line runs 9:00–17:30, closed 1–3 January (official site). Takeaway mainly; the tea room has 4 seats at 2 tables and serves fresh wagashi and kakigori (Tabelog; September 2026); the 吉村和菓子店 corner is at the back (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR; paper bags for a fee (Tabelog; September 2026). On Shijo-dori west of Aburanokoji; 5–6 min from Hankyu Omiya Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_kameya_yoshinaga_honten.notes: [Wagashi · Shijo-Horikawa, a confectioner since 1803] An old Kyoto confectioner on Shijo-dori, founded in 1803 and still making its signature 烏羽玉: small jet-black balls of smooth bean paste and Hateruma black sugar, glossy with agar (six for ¥540). The bright, renovated shop also sells modern lines — An no Hako, bean-paste spreads, seasonal assortments — under the 亀屋良長, Satomi Fujita and 吉村和菓子店 names, and a four-seat tea room serves fresh wagashi and summer kakigori. Mostly takeaway. Daily 9:30–18:00.

roles: Family confectioner; the site links to the 八代目 (eighth generation) and the okami on X; no names read
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in 1803; brands 亀屋良長, Satomi Fujita and 吉村和菓子店; wagashi-making classes and a collaboration with SOU・SOU. Per 2026 reviews: an independent offshoot of Kameya Yoshian from the Edo period, which settled at Shijo-Sakai for good water; the ubatama, made with Hateruma black sugar, has been made since the founding (September 2026); a September 2026 visitor found the store newly opened and beautiful, staffed by polite young women, with new gluten-free products.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per 2026 reviews: cherishing traditional Kyoto sweets while bringing in techniques and ingredients from Western confectionery.
chef_bio.specialty: 烏羽玉; Kyo Monaka; An no Hako.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor called the ubatama "small, jet-black balls beautifully arranged" that shimmered in the light.
An October 2026 buyer found the shiruko easy to make, with a fortune slip read from the shape of its amber jelly.
An October 2026 visitor thought the Ichiyo Raifuku bean crackers deserve to be better known.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kameya-yoshinaga.com): 創業1803年の京菓子司 亀屋良長、ブランド: 亀屋良長、Satomi Fujita、吉村和菓子店、烏羽玉、スライスようかん、もなか、おしるこ、涼菓、餅菓子、焼き菓子、せんべい、干菓子、羊羹、和菓子手づくり教室、SOU・SOU×亀屋良長、電話 9:00〜17:30 (1月1日〜3日休み)。食べログ: 和菓子、下京区四条通油小路西入柏屋町17-19、大宮駅から351m、販売9:30〜18:00、茶房11:00〜17:00、1月1日・2日休み、4席 (2卓)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、テイクアウト、奥に吉村和菓子店のコーナー、メニュー (2026年1月更新): 烏羽玉 (6個) 540円。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 烏羽玉 (Hateruma の黒糖)、An no Hako、Kyo Monaka、Ichiyo Raifuku、Hane Usagi のおしるこ540円、1803年創業、Kameya Yoshian からの暖簾分け、グルテンフリーの品も。

cultural_comfort.note: Mostly takeaway; a four-seat tea room for fresh wagashi.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing (menu January 2026); reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_bassanova.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen noodles in every bowl (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_bassanova.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the green-curry, tom yum and laksa broths come with chicken chashu, and one diner tasted a seafood base (June 2025).
kyoto_bassanova.hours_raw: Tabelog: every day 11:00–15:00 and 16:00–21:00; hours may change. A diner in July 2024 found it open on a Wednesday although a website listed Wednesday as closed; it once stayed open late at night (December 2023). Ticket machine; no reservations; cards and QR, though one diner found PayPay missing (Tabelog; 2023 review). Counter and some tables; non-smoking (Tabelog; January 2024). Opened 1 July 2023 (Tabelog). At the back of the 舟木ビル off the Teramachi Kyogoku arcade, an entrance that is easy to miss (2024 reviews); 5 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn.
kyoto_bassanova.notes: [Ramen · Teramachi, Thai curry ramen] The Kyoto branch, opened July 2023, of BASSANOVA, the Shindaita ramen shop that made green-curry ramen its name: a creamy, gently spiced coconut broth with curly noodles and grilled chicken chashu, plus tom yum and laksa versions and cold bowls in summer. Hidden at the back of a building off the Teramachi arcade. Prices rose in 2026 (green curry ¥1,700 in July); some diners now find it pricey for the portion. 11:00–15:00, 16:00–21:00.

roles: Kyoto branch of BASSANOVA (Tokyo)
chef_bio.background: Per reviews: BASSANOVA began in Shindaita, Tokyo, nearly 20 years before a December 2023 visit, first known for Hakata noodles in a rich pork-bone broth with Japanese dashi and then for Thai curry ramen; a January 2024 diner names locations in Shindaita and Shinjuku and calls Kyoto the first in Kansai, opened in July 2023 (Tabelog: 1 July 2023). A December 2023 diner noticed the noodles are now medium-thin and chewy rather than Hakata-style.
chef_bio.specialty: Green curry ramen.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 diner said it tasted almost the same as Nissin’s instant green curry ramen — "In a way, it made me appreciate the greatness of Nissin!"
A July 2026 regular found the green curry ramen lukewarm, with cold toppings, and wondered whether ¥1,700 was worth it.
"I have visited BASSANOVA several times since it opened in Shindaita nearly 20 years ago." — December 2023.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ラーメン、中京区式部町259 舟木ビル 1F、毎日11:00〜15:00・16:00〜21:00、予約不可、カード・QR 可、電子マネー不可、カウンター、禁煙、2023年7月1日オープン。口コミ (2023年10月〜2026年8月、英語): 東京・新代田発、グリーンカレーラーメン1,200円 (2026年7月は1,700円)、トムヤムクンラーメン1,200円、ラクサラーメン1,300円、冷やしもあり、パクチー200円、煮卵200円、鶏チャーシュー250円、チャーシュー丼600円、締めのチーズリゾット、中太の縮れ麺、券売機、入口がわかりにくい。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the ticket machine; three soups to choose from; no bookings.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_shushu_shenjian.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pan-fried soup dumplings in a wheat wrapper, scallion-oil noodles and wontons (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shushu_shenjian.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the dumplings are pork (or shrimp and pork) in chicken stock (Tabelog), though side dishes such as dried tofu salad and wood ear with mustard greens appear in the sets (2026 reviews).
kyoto_shushu_shenjian.hours_raw: Tabelog: 11:00–20:30, closed Tuesday. Bookings by phone only (Tabelog; diners also booked through Tabelog in 2025–2026). 10 seats at five tables for two; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). PayPay only, no cards or e-money (Tabelog). Order by smartphone; self-service water (June 2026). Takeaway and delivery (Tabelog; April 2025). English menu (Tabelog). Opened 18 January 2022 (Tabelog). In the 舟木ビル off the Teramachi arcade, behind a large xiaolongbao model at the door (August 2026); 5 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn.
kyoto_shushu_shenjian.notes: [Soup dumplings · Teramachi, Shanghai shengjian] A 10-seat Shanghai-style shop for pan-fried soup dumplings — crisp-bottomed, wrapped to order and full of hot broth (bite carefully, add black vinegar) — in the original pork or a green-skinned shrimp version, sold in sets with small sides and Chinese tea. Manpuku set ¥1,780 (2026). Reviews split: many love the juicy dumplings; a November 2025 diner found the noodles and wontons poor and the service cold. 11:00–20:30, closed Tuesday; PayPay only.

roles: Shop (operator not named on the sources read)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s introduction: opened in January 2022 (opening day 18 January 2022), proud of handmade xiaolongbao wrapped just before cooking with flavourful chicken stock and fresh pork, three good-value sets for drinking, and a retro Shanghai interior. An April 2025 diner heard from staff that Uber Eats couriers collect often; another found the room full of overseas guests.
chef_bio.specialty: Pan-fried soup dumplings (shengjian).

anecdotes.text: "I still wonder why the skin is green, but the burst of shrimp flavor is irresistible." — April 2025.
A November 2025 diner found the dumplings full of soup but the scallion-oil noodles and wontons disappointing, and the male staff member expressionless and cold.
"The staff kindly explained how to eat the hot xiaolongbao, and there were instructions on the menu as well." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 小籠包・バル・居酒屋、中京区式部町259-1 舟木ビル 1F、11:00〜20:30、火曜定休、予約は電話のみ、10席 (2名テーブル×5)、禁煙、子連れ・ベビーカー可、PayPay のみ (カード・電子マネー不可)、テイクアウト・デリバリー、英語メニュー、2022年1月18日オープン、包みたての手作り焼き小籠包、鶏がらスープと新鮮な豚肉、3種のお得なセット、レトロな上海の店内。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年9月、英語): 豚の生煎と緑の皮の海老入り、黒酢、満腹セット1,780円、葱油拌麺580円、紅油抄手、干し豆腐の和え物、白桃烏龍茶、スマホで注文。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog) and smartphone ordering; staff explain how to eat the dumplings; PayPay only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_marukyu_koyamaen_motoan.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The tea room serves matcha and other teas with wagashi, ice cream, a matcha roll cake and summer shaved ice (official menu); the sweets are not described.
kyoto_marukyu_koyamaen_motoan.vegan_detail: Ask. The teas themselves (matcha, sencha, gyokuro, hojicha, genmaicha) suit, but the ice creams, roll cake and cream teas use dairy, and the wagashi are not described (official menu).
kyoto_marukyu_koyamaen_motoan.hours_raw: Official site: shop 9:30–18:00; tea room 10:30–17:00 last order (closing 17:30); closed every Wednesday, the third Tuesday and the New Year. Tabelog gives Wednesday closed (open on holidays). No reservations for seats; the take-home matcha roll cake (¥3,780 a 15 cm roll) is by phone order only, not on the day, collected at the shop (official site). The tea room seats about 10–13 and includes a two-mat tea room (no tea ceremony performed) facing a garden; non-smoking; children welcome (official site; Tabelog). Cards, IC and QR payments (Tabelog). On Nishinotoin-dori south of Oike; 6 min walk from Karasuma Oike or Nijojo-mae stations (Tabelog).
kyoto_marukyu_koyamaen_motoan.notes: [Tea room · Nishinotoin-Oike, an Uji tea house's own shop] The Kyoto shop of Marukyu Koyamaen, a tea house from the Genroku era: buy matcha and gyokuro in front, then sit in the small tea room Motoan at the back, looking onto a garden, for usucha and wagashi (from ¥1,595), Uji matcha ice cream (¥990) or the matcha roll cake set (¥1,925), with shaved ice in summer. Cafe WEST Tabelog 100 2025. No bookings for seats; the tea room is small. 9:30–18:00 (tea room to 17:00 last order), closed Wednesdays and the third Tuesday.

roles: Directly run shop of the tea company 丸久小山園 (Uji)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Marukyu Koyamaen’s directly run shops are all in Kyoto — the headquarters shop, this Nishinotoin shop with the tea room 元庵, and counters in JR Kyoto Isetan and Kyoto Takashimaya; the Nishinotoin shop sells matcha, gyokuro, sencha and genmaicha and matcha sweets, and its tea room includes a proper two-mat tea room where the menu can be enjoyed without a tea ceremony. An October 2026 review gives the founding as the Genroku era and the tea room as a renovated 100-year-old townhouse. Tabelog Cafe WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Usucha with wagashi; matcha roll cake.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 buyer of the summer Uji matcha kanten jelly was disappointed to find the matcha in a separate packet to sprinkle on.
A September 2026 visitor’s friend quoted the Southern Song poet Lu You on the rainy Kyoto afternoon over a cup of matcha.
"Although it's a bit away from the bustling area, there are many foreign visitors." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (marukyu-koyamaen.co.jp): 西洞院店・茶房「元庵」、ショップは抹茶・玉露・煎茶・玄米茶と抹茶のお菓子、茶房は抹茶・煎茶・ほうじ茶と和菓子のセット、アイスクリーム、ロールケーキ (席数13)、本格的な二畳の茶室 (茶道の点前はなし)、中京区西洞院通御池下ル西側、茶房10:30〜17:00ラストオーダー (17:30閉店)、売店9:30〜18:00、毎週水曜日・第3火曜日・年末年始休み、メニュー (税込): 抹茶「雅の院」(西洞院店限定) 薄茶と和菓子1,595円、宇治抹茶アイスクリーム990円、京ほうじ茶アイスクリーム880円、抹茶「長安」薄茶と和菓子2,035円・濃茶と和菓子2,860円、玉露「滴の院」と和菓子2,255円、ほうじ茶と和菓子1,430円、抹茶のロールケーキセット1,925円 (1カット1,100円、予約不可・売り切れ次第終了)、抹茶かき氷「京氷室」1,210円・抹茶あずき氷1,320円 (夏季のみ)、抹茶ぜんざい (冬季のみ)、濃茶の薄葉ごはん1,600円 (午後2時まで)、持ち帰りのロールケーキ1本3,780円 (完全事前電話予約制)。会社概要: 直営店は京都のみ (本社直売店、西洞院店・茶房元庵、ジェイアール京都伊勢丹店、京都高島屋店)。食べログ: カフェ・甘味処・かき氷、水曜休み (祝日は営業)、10席、禁煙、子供可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、カフェ WEST 百名店 2025。

cultural_comfort.note: Order tea sets from a short menu in the small tea room; the official site has Chinese pages; no bookings.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026; Cafe WEST Tabelog 100 2025.

kyoto_marukyu_koyamaen_motoan.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260202/26006904/ (35.010151, 135.755058); GSI resolves the lot-less address only to 中京区 (ward), so the pin rests on the Tabelog point; 2026-11-05

kyoto_tempura_yoshikawa.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the official site says the restaurant cannot cater for gluten-free diets; the cooking is battered tempura.
kyoto_tempura_yoshikawa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the official site says vegan diets cannot be catered for; a vegetarian menu is offered for an extra charge.
kyoto_tempura_yoshikawa.hours_raw: Official site and Tabelog: tempura counter lunch 11:00–13:30 last order (closes 15:00), dinner 17:30–20:00 last order (closes 22:00); private rooms lunch 12:00–13:30 and dinner 17:30–19:30 last order; closed Tuesday and Wednesday (may open by season; counter closed 31 Dec and 1 Jan). Reservation only; same-day changes to numbers or diet requests cannot be accommodated; cancellation fees apply; 30 minutes late without contact counts as a cancellation (Tabelog). Service charge: private rooms 15%, counter 5% at dinner only (Tabelog; official site). Counter: no children aged 5 or under; private rooms take children with a kids’ course from ¥3,000 (official site; Tabelog). About 100 seats: 8 private rooms with garden views, a hall for up to 25, and the counter (8 seats per Tabelog; 11 per an August 2026 review); designated smoking area, e-cigarettes only in private rooms; paid parking for 3 cars by reservation (Tabelog). English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Tominokoji south of Oike; 5 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_tempura_yoshikawa.notes: [Tempura · Tominokoji-Oike, a ryokan's tea-room counter] A cooking ryokan founded in 1952 in an early-Taisho sukiya house with part of a garden attributed to Kobori Enshu; in 1964 it turned the tea room into a tempura counter, rare in Kyoto then. Counter lunch of 12 pieces, shrimp first and last, ¥6,600 (2026); dinners and garden-room kaiseki cost more. Tempura Tabelog 100 2022, 2023, 2025. The house cannot cater for vegan or gluten-free diets. One June 2026 diner found the batter thick and the service hurried. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday; reservation only.

roles: Cooking ryokan (料理旅館) and tempura counter; no chef named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Yoshikawa opened in 1952 on its present site as an inn; the sukiya building dates from the early Taisho era, and the main garden, about a third of the property, is older and is said to be by Kobori Enshu; the house was once the home of the poet 江馬天江, who was involved in founding what is now Ritsumeikan University, and works by 太田垣蓮月 and 富岡鉄斎 remain; the eight rooms are each furnished differently; itamae tempura, then rare in Kyoto, began in 1964, the year of the Tokyo Olympics, in a converted tea room. Tabelog gives the opening day as 1 February 1952. Diners in October 2026 had come for over 20 and 30 years; one notes more tourists, including overseas guests, than before.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to be a cooking ryokan where guests feel as relaxed as on coming home ("okaeriyasu").
chef_bio.specialty: Counter tempura lunch; kakiage.

anecdotes.text: "I've been coming here for 30 years… I always place an additional order at the end, and that’s for the kakiage." — October 2026.
A June 2026 diner found the lily bulb and pumpkin slightly hard, the batter thick, and the serving and handling of utensils hurried.
A July 2026 family celebrated a daughter’s wedding with a tempura course in a garden-view private room during the Gion Festival.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoto-yoshikawa.co.jp): 料理旅館・天ぷら 吉川、京都御苑近く、戦後に料理旅館として創業、「退享園」(退去園) と呼ばれた小堀遠州作と伝わる庭園、豪商の住まいの数奇屋造りの館。吉川について: 1952年に片泊まりの宿として創業、建物は大正初期、庭は小堀遠州作と聞き及ぶ、漢詩人の江馬天江の住まい、太田垣蓮月尼や富岡鉄斎の作品、八室のしつらえはすべて異なる、1964年の東京オリンピックに合わせて茶室を改装して板前天ぷらを始めた。お食事: お昼12:00〜13:30 L.O. (15時閉館)、夜17:30〜19:30 L.O. (22時閉館)、天ぷら会席、ハモ・蟹・フグ・クエの特別コース、消費税・奉仕料15%別、ベジタリアン対応 (追加料金)、ヴィーガン・グルテンフリーは対応致しかねます、天ぷらカウンター 11:00〜13:30 L.O.・17:30〜20:00 L.O.、奉仕料5% (昼のカウンターは消費税のみ)、5歳以下は不可、カウンター貸切 (最大10名)、法事やお子様メニュー。食べログ: 天ぷら・日本料理・料理旅館、中京区富小路通御池下ル松下町135、火・水曜休み、完全予約制、100席 (個室8、広間最大25名、カウンター8席)、英語メニュー・英語のスタッフ、カード可、駐車場3台 (要予約)、1952年2月1日オープン、天ぷら百名店 2022・2023・2025。口コミ (2026年6月〜10月、英語): カウンターのランチ6,600円で12品、海老で始まり海老で終わる、天茶+1,100円、抹茶塩と天つゆ、30年通う客。

kyoto_nihonshu_to_oryori_oyu.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai, sashimi, simmered pork cartilage with ponzu, spring rolls, tempura and keema curry; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_nihonshu_to_oryori_oyu.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: obanzai and snacks with fish (shirasu, herring, sardines), pork and tuna; the appetiser is shirasu (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nihonshu_to_oryori_oyu.hours_raw: 14:00–22:00, last food order 21:00, every day; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Afternoon drinking from 14:00 is a draw (Tabelog shop text). Reservations accepted (Tabelog; March 2026). An appetiser (otoshi) charge (Tabelog). 15 seats: 6 at the counter and 3 tables; non-smoking, with a smoking spot outside; children welcome (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), no e-money or QR (Tabelog). On Kawaramachi-dori north of Matsubara; 10 min walk from Kiyomizu-Gojo or Kyoto-Kawaramachi stations (Tabelog). Opened 12 September 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_nihonshu_to_oryori_oyu.notes: [Sake izakaya · Kawaramachi-Matsubara, warm sake from 14:00] A small, bright modern counter on Kawaramachi south of Shijo, run by a woman owner who trained at Manzara-tei, opening at 14:00 for afternoon drinking: over 30 sakes, many served warm — the name, "hot water", is for sake that warms you like a bath — with careful obanzai, sashimi and the signature soft-simmered pork cartilage with ponzu. Reviewers praise the home-style cooking and let the owner choose their sake. An otoshi charge applies. Open daily from 14:00 to 22:00.

roles: Owner (a woman, unnamed), who cooks and chooses the sake
chef_bio.background: Per a May 2026 review: run by a female owner and staff, both from Manzara-tei. A September 2026 review explains that the owner named the shop hoping guests would feel warmed from the inside by kanzake, as if soaking in hot water; an October 2026 visitor saw the owner managing everything alone; a July 2026 regular now chats with the owner and staff. The shop was listed in "Japanese Sake dancyu 2026" (March 2026 review). Opened 12 September 2024 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the Tabelog shop text: warm sake that comforts you like a hot bath.
chef_bio.specialty: Kanzake; simmered pork cartilage; obanzai.

anecdotes.text: "In my 65 years of life, I've been to many restaurants, but for some reason, this one feels particularly comfortable." — July 2026.
"I appreciated the thoughtful gesture of splitting one serving into portions depending on the dish's volume" — March 2026.
"Even while managing everything alone, the quality of the menu was remarkable." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 居酒屋、下京区河原町通松原上る清水町282、清水五条駅・京都河原町駅から徒歩10分、毎日14:00〜22:00 (料理 L.O. 21:00)、不定休、予約可、お通し代あり、15席 (カウンター6、テーブル3)、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、子供可、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、2024年9月12日オープン、店舗紹介: 湯につかるように温まる燗酒、中央市場の旬の刺身とおばんざい、豚なんこつの煮込み、30種以上の日本酒、14時からの昼飲み。口コミ (2026年3〜10月、英語): 女性の店主とスタッフ (ともに Manzara-tei 出身)、肴の盛り合わせ8種1,500円、鮎ときゅうりの春巻き1,200円、いちごと黒豆の白和え、鯖のきずし、ほたるいかとうどの天ぷら、にしんなす、キーマカレー、燗酒、Japanese Sake dancyu 2026 に掲載、店主一人で切り盛り。

kyoto_torishin_nawate.gf_detail: Ask. Oyakodon in a dashi-and-tare sauce at lunch; yakitori with tare or salt at night; no gluten information (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_torishin_nawate.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken house — oyakodon of chicken and egg at lunch, chicken skewers and chicken soup at night (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_torishin_nawate.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 (oyakodon only: large, regular, small or takeaway), dinner 18:00–22:00; closed Thursday (Tabelog). No reservations at lunch; dinner can be booked (Tabelog). Lunch queues are common, though some reviewers walked straight in (2025 reviews). Cash only; smoking allowed (Tabelog). 14 seats: 6 at the counter and two tables (Tabelog). On Nawate (Yamato-oji) north of Shijo, at the north end of Yamato-bashi over the Shirakawa; 3 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (official site; Tabelog).
kyoto_torishin_nawate.notes: [Yakitori & oyakodon · Gion Shirakawa, a Meiji chicken family's casual shop] The casual counter of 鳥新, a Gion chicken house whose family traces itself to the mid-Meiji era and whose earlier shops appear in Ryōma ga Yuku and Tanizaki. At lunch it serves only oyakodon — the old geisha-delivery recipe, egg set round a raw yolk with Kujo onion on Tsuruga rice, with house pickles and miso soup; at night, a ¥2,200 skewer omakase with chicken soup. Cash only; smoking allowed; closed Thursday.

roles: Owner, fourth generation by the family’s count (official site); unnamed
chef_bio.background: Per the official site of 鳥新: founded about 120 years ago in the mid-Meiji era, with the present owner "said to be the fourth generation" though without firm proof; related 鳥新 shops once stood by Shijo Kobashi, on Kawaramachi, Teramachi and Shinkyogoku, and the family traces bird dealing back to Oda Nobunaga’s time; the Shijo Kobashi shop is thought to be the one in the last scene of Shiba Ryōtarō’s "Ryōma ga Yuku"; Tanizaki Jun’ichirō wrote of the Teramachi shop (Bungei Shunjū, 1924) and ate at Nawate; mizutaki came to dominate over sukiyaki from about Showa 40. The oyakodon was made for delivery to geiko, maiko and Gion households from the late Meiji, delivery ended around 1955, and the dish was revived for lunch at とり新 after some fifty years (official site). An August 2025 reviewer found the owner a person of few words who wore very tall geta; an April 2026 reviewer calls the house Meiji-era.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "町の普通の店" — an ordinary neighbourhood shop, a secret little space in Kyoto.
chef_bio.specialty: Oyakodon; yakitori omakase.

anecdotes.text: "The owner, wearing incredibly high geta (traditional wooden sandals), brought it to me...!" The owner seemed a person of few words, but warned of the weather on the way out. — August 2025.
A March 2026 diner took the ¥2,200 skewer omakase with a medium Super Dry (¥770) and found it surprisingly affordable for Gion, with a friendly, chatty owner.
"The donburi (rice bowl) was a classic oyakodon, with the eggs cooked to perfection" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (torishin.my.coocan.jp、鳥新): 創業は約120年前の明治中頃、四代目と一応言われている、四条小橋・河原町・寺町・新京極にも鳥新があった、織田信長入洛の頃から鳥屋、司馬遼太郎『竜馬がゆく』の最後の場面の小橋の店、谷崎潤一郎『上方の食ひもの』(文藝春秋1924年) の寺町の店、縄手通り大和橋北詰東側、昭和40年過ぎから水だきが主流、水だき・すき焼きの2コース、とり新は昼に親子丼: 九条か賀茂の青葱、福井・敦賀産のコシヒカリ、真ん中に黄身、卵約2.5個、自家製の漬物と味噌、明治末〜大正初めから出前、昭和30年ごろ出前を廃止、約50年ぶりに営業、焼き鳥の山椒は七味家、アサヒスーパードライ、Instagram ktorishin。食べログ: 焼き鳥・鶏料理・親子丼、東山区祇園縄手四条上ル、祇園四条駅から徒歩3分、昼12:00〜14:00 (親子丼のみ、予約不可)・夜18:00〜22:00、木曜休み、14席、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、喫煙可。口コミ (2025年6月〜2026年10月、英語): 親子丼、行列、高い下駄の店主、串のおまかせ2,200円、中瓶770円、鶏スープ、掘りごたつの個室で水炊き (2025年11月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Lunch is oyakodon only — sit and it comes; cash only; smoky.

kyoto_hiiragiya_ryokan.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki; the inn handles food allergies and vegetarian requests "as far as possible" with three days’ notice (official site FAQ); no gluten-specific information.
kyoto_hiiragiya_ryokan.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetarian requests are handled as far as possible with three days’ notice; halal and kosher cannot be done (official site FAQ). The standard kaiseki uses fish, crab and dashi (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_hiiragiya_ryokan.hours_raw: A ryokan: dinner starts at 18:00 or 19:00 and breakfast at 8:00 or 9:00 for guests (official site FAQ). Dining without staying is possible by reservation — dinner from two people, lunch for groups of ten or more outside busy periods (official site FAQ; Tabelog says lunch from 15); 10% service charge for meals only (Tabelog). Allergies and vegetarian requests three days ahead; special orders five days ahead (official site FAQ). Meals in the guest room, a shared dining room or a hall; tables and chairs on request (official site; 2024 review). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (official site). Corkage charged on brought drinks (official site). Phone 8:00–21:00 (official site). On Fuyacho north of Aneyakoji, just off Oike-dori; about 4 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (official site; August 2026).
kyoto_hiiragiya_ryokan.notes: [Ryokan kaiseki · Fuyacho, one of Kyoto's grand old inns] A historic inn near Oike, in the inn trade since 1861 (the house since 1818), whose holly crest is on everything and whose guests have included Kawabata Yasunari: seasonal Kyoto kaiseki in your room or a dining room, with fine old tableware. You can come just to eat — dinner for two or more, lunch for groups of ten — by booking ahead; allergies and vegetarian requests need three days' notice. Expect ¥20,000–50,000 a head. A 2026 Michelin Key hotel and Relais & Châteaux member.

roles: Head chef (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: in 1818 the first 庄五郎 came from Fukui and set up in transport and seafood here; the name comes from the holly-shrine 比良木神社 at Shimogamo; the second generation, a sword-fitting craftsman, made the inn the main business in 1861; guests have included Bakumatsu activists, nobility and men of letters, and the site carries Kawabata Yasunari’s essay on the inn; registered tangible cultural property; selected as a 2026 Michelin Key hotel (September 2026) and joined Relais & Châteaux (July 2026). Reviewers give the founding as 1850 (August 2026) and call it one of Kyoto’s three great ryokan; a July 2026 reviewer mentions guests such as Charlie Chaplin and Mishima Yukio.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: 来者如帰 — "may you feel as if you had come home".
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal Kyoto kaiseki; Kyoto breakfast with yudofu.

anecdotes.text: "Dining Only: First Meal Celebration … As expected from a ryokan, the treatment for children was exceptional." — December 2024.
"The hotel accommodated my allergies and provided excellent alternatives using fish." — January 2024.
"A maiko also came to visit, making our dining experience even more enjoyable." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (hiiragiya.co.jp): 来者如帰、文政元年 (1818) 福井から上った初代庄五郎が運送業・海産物商、屋号は下鴨神社境内の比良木神社から、文久元年 (1861) に宿を本業に、国登録有形文化財、川端康成の寄稿文、夕食は京懐石、朝食は湯豆腐・焼き魚・土鍋ご飯・自家製漬物 (洋食も可)、夕食18:00か19:00開始、食物アレルギー・ベジタリアンは3日前までに可能な範囲で、ハラル・コーシャは不可、特別注文は5日前まで、食事のみの利用は夕食2名から・昼食は繁忙期以外10名以上、持ち込みは抜栓料、カード可、2026年ミシュランキーホテル、ルレ・エ・シャトー加盟 (2026年7月)、別注の天然鱧・天然鮎 (2026年夏)。食べログ: 旅館・日本料理、中京区麩屋町姉小路上ル中白山町277、完全予約制、料理のみはサービス料10%、昼食15名以上、48席 (広間)、個室あり。口コミ (2024年1月〜2026年10月、英語): Kyoto Gosan-ke、創業1850年、夕食は部屋か食事処、蕎麦、鱧、鮎、毛蟹、Matsuba crab、食事のみのお食い初め、舞妓、川端康成の部屋。

cultural_comfort.note: English website; book ahead (dinner from two diners); allergies and vegetarian requests three days ahead.

staff_allergy_handling: Handles food allergies and vegetarian requests as far as possible with three days’ notice; no halal or kosher (official site FAQ).
