kyoto_moko_french.gf_detail: Ask. Course French with homemade sourdough campagne at every meal, sauces built on bread, koji and miso, and aged fish and meat; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_moko_french.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses centre on aged fish, game and meat, with butter and caviar (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_moko_french.hours_raw: Tuesday dinner 18:00–22:00 (last food order 19:30); Wednesday to Saturday lunch 12:00–14:30 (last order 13:00) and dinner 18:00–22:00 (last order 19:30); closed Sunday and Monday (Tabelog). Reservation only (Tabelog). 38 seats: a 14-seat counter, tables and private rooms for 2–8; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). A kids’ menu for small children (June and October 2026). In a renovated townhouse with a courtyard and a storehouse at the back, near Marutamachi Stn (2026 reviews; Tabelog).
kyoto_moko_french.notes: [French · Marutamachi, Chef Alexey Moko's townhouse] A modern French restaurant in a renovated Kyoto townhouse with a central counter, a courtyard and a storehouse, where Chef Alexey Moko — trained at Taillevent and in London hotels — cooks Japanese ingredients aged and fermented in-house: week-aged fish with koji or sourdough-miso sauces, game, and a sourdough loaf with butter people ask for again and again. Lunch ¥9,000, dinner ¥22,000, with natural-wine pairings. Families welcome, with a kids' menu. Michelin one star, per reviewers. Closed Sunday and Monday.

roles: Owner-chef (reviews: "an owner-chef from Versailles")
chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: Alexey Moko worked at renowned places such as Taillevent in France and hotels in London (March 2026); an owner-chef from Versailles focusing on fermentation and ageing (October 2026); the restaurant gained a Michelin star soon after opening, about three years ago (August and March 2026); the long-time service manager, who spoke fluent English and looked after international guests, left in August 2026; an October 2026 family was looked after by Chef Alexey and the chef’s wife. An April 2026 reviewer found most guests were from overseas.
chef_bio.specialty: Aged and fermented fish and game; sourdough with butter.

anecdotes.text: "The butter and salt served with the bread were so delicious that I ended up asking for three extra servings." — December 2025.
An October 2026 family with a two-and-a-half-year-old found Chef Alexey and the chef’s wife "incredibly kind and attentive".
A July 2026 diner loved the townhouse space but found the flavours a little strong and the ¥5,000-a-glass "Prestige" pairing pricey for what it was.
"Most of the guests were from overseas." — April 2026.

kyoto_gion_sakamoto.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Kyoto kappo courses on dashi — yuba, sesame tofu with fuki-miso, clear soup, seasonal bamboo shoots; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_sakamoto.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: omakase kappo courses with fish and dashi (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_sakamoto.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00, dinner 17:00–22:00; closing days not fixed; reservation only (Tabelog). 12 seats: 6 at the counter, 6 at tables; window seats look over the Shirakawa; private hire possible; non-smoking; cards accepted (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). kyoto_gion_sakamoto.notes: [Kappo · Gion Shirakawa, dinner over the stream] A small kappo counter on the Shirakawa in Gion, open since 1977 per a reviewer, where window seats look over the stream and, in spring, illuminated cherry blossoms. Omakase courses of seasonal Kyoto cooking — yuba, bamboo shoots, sesame tofu — with Fushimi sake. Reservation only; expect ¥20,000 a head and up. The entrance is tucked away.

roles: Owner and chef (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per a June 2025 review: in business since October 1977, reservation only. A June 2021 reviewer was welcomed by a woman who seemed to be the owner; a November 2022 reviewer heard the manager had studied cooking in America.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kappo omakase; yuba.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 window table had the illuminated cherry blossoms across the Shirakawa, with Kyoto bamboo shoots and Fushimi sake.
An April 2024 diner thought ¥85,000 for two hard to square with courses of about ¥20,000 a head.
The owner and staff were "very friendly", and the chef’s sake pairing suited the reviewer — January 2025.

kyoto_renkonya.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai and izakaya dishes with soy-based simmering — nikujaga with a strong soy taste, beef shigureni, tonjiru, karashi renkon with a miso-mustard filling; no gluten information (guide article; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_renkonya.vegan_detail: Ask. Pickles, chilled tofu, grilled eggplant, Manganji peppers and okara are on the menu, but obanzai are usually simmered in dashi and much of the menu is meat or fish (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_renkonya.hours_raw: 17:00–22:30, Monday to Saturday; closed Sunday (Tabelog); a travel guide gives 17:00–23:00 (last order) and says the shop opens on a holiday Monday and closes the Tuesday instead. Bookings taken; walk-ins sometimes fit (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews). 20 seats: a counter of about four, two tables for four and three small tables for two on a raised tatami floor (Tabelog; April 2025). Non-smoking; JCB, AMEX, Diners and e-money (Tabelog). On Nishikiyamachi-dori south of Sanjo, by the Takase River; 5 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; guide).
kyoto_renkonya.notes: [Obanzai izakaya · Kiyamachi south of Sanjo, an old townhouse] A tiny, wood-built izakaya by the Takase River, running since 1950 per a travel guide, in an Edo-era townhouse with an okudo hearth and low tables: Kyoto home-style obanzai and sake, with the house karashi renkon (lotus root stuffed with miso mustard), simmered dishes and onigiri to finish. Cosy and often busy with visitors; book or call ahead. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who cooks every dish (April 2025 review)
chef_bio.background: Per a travel-guide article (aquadina.com, undated): a long-established izakaya since 1950, centred on obanzai lined up on the counter; the interior is an Edo-period townhouse where the okudo, a black telephone and low chabudai tables are still in use.
chef_bio.specialty: Karashi renkon; obanzai.

anecdotes.text: Ordering pickled eggplant, a guest was offered it old, regular or lightly pickled — May 2025.
"It seems the owner is cooking all the dishes" — April 2025; the same reviewers found the small raised tables cramped.
An August 2025 diner, after the Gozan no Okuribi, noted many foreign guests and a casual dress code with lots of tank tops.
A kitchen mix-up left an order of okara unclaimed, and a late guest got it at half price — September 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 観光ガイド記事 (aquadina.com、日付なし): れんこん屋、1950年から続く老舗の居酒屋、カウンターに並ぶおばんざい中心、自家製からしれんこん (白味噌をブレンドした辛子味噌) 700円、わかさかれい1,600円、たたきとろろ800円、にしきぎ600円、江戸時代の町家、おくどさん・黒電話・ちゃぶ台、17:00〜23:00 (L.O)、日曜休み (月曜が祝日の場合は営業し月曜休み)。食べログ: 居酒屋・日本料理・郷土料理、中京区西木屋町通り三条下ル山崎町236、三条駅から247m、月〜土 17:00〜22:30、日曜休み、予約可、20席、禁煙、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)・電子マネー可。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年10月、英語): からしれんこん、肉じゃが800円、漬物300円、牛しぐれ煮、おから、万願寺とうがらし、てっぱい、鶏レバー、おにぎり、豚汁、湯豆腐、店主が一人で料理、海外からの客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Small and busy; call ahead; obanzai are ordered from the counter display.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_tokura_sanjo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: hamburg steak, demi-glace and red-wine sauces, fried shrimp, roll bread (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_tokura_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a hamburg-steak specialist (official site).
kyoto_tokura_sanjo.hours_raw: 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–20:30; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). No reservations: weekend queues from about 11:30 with waits of 20–40 minutes; orders are taken in the line and parasols lent in the sun (Tabelog; October 2026). Takeaway (official site). Counter seating; non-smoking; JCB and AMEX, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Ground floor of 京都三条ビル; 4 min from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_tokura_sanjo.notes: [Hamburg steak · Sanjo near Karasuma] The Sanjo branch of a Kyoto hamburg-steak specialist: plump handmade patties that flood with juice when cut, a choice of 12 sauces, and rice from Hachidaime Gihei. Original hamburg about ¥1,030; 300 g ¥1,250. Expect a short queue at lunch — orders are taken while you wait. Yoshoku WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Operator unnamed in the sources
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the main shop is in Kuze, Minami-ku, with another branch in Takeda, Fushimi-ku. The shop site announced a Lucua Osaka shop opening on 5 April 2022. Per the shop site: the onion moisture and fat ratio are adjusted day by day to keep the taste constant. Tabelog Yoshoku WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the shop site: "肉汁溢れるハンバーグといえば「とくら」" — the hamburg that overflows with juices.
chef_bio.specialty: Original hamburg steak.

anecdotes.text: While queuing, guests were lent sun umbrellas and orders were taken — October 2026.
Many Korean customers were there and the staff spoke fluent Korean; the corn potage was slightly powdery — October 2026.
A diner who finds the Osaka Tokura lines too long got in here with little wait — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (tokura-hamburg.com): 手づくりハンバーグの店 とくら、肉汁溢れるハンバーグ、玉ネギの水分や肉の脂肪分を見ながら日によって配合を微調整、赤ワイン仕立てのオリジナルソースやおろしポン酢など12種類のソース、テイクアウト、ルクア大阪店 2022年4月5日オープン。食べログ: ハンバーグ、中京区桝屋町57 京都三条ビル 1F、烏丸御池駅から徒歩4分、月火木〜日 11:00〜15:00・17:00〜20:30、水曜休み、予約不可、カウンター席、禁煙、カード (JCB・AMEX)・電子マネー・QR 可、本店は南区久世上久世町516-6、伏見区竹田中畑町24に支店、洋食 WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2026年10月、英語): オリジナルハンバーグ1,030円、ライス275円、300g 1,250円、和風セット+345円、チーズ、ねぎ味噌、明太子、エビフライ、Hachidaime Gihei の米、行列。

cultural_comfort.note: Queue and order in line; counter seats; cards (JCB, AMEX) accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and shop site; reviews dated through October 2026; Yoshoku WEST Tabelog 100 2025.

kyoto_hikari_yurari.gf_detail: Ask. Italian small plates — prosciutto, pâté, potato salad, cheese, soups, pasta; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_hikari_yurari.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: cured hams, pâté and cheese lead the menu (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_hikari_yurari.hours_raw: 18:00–23:00 (last seating 22:00; food last order 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Tuesday and every other Monday (Tabelog). Reservation only, by phone; same-day bookings possible; reviewers say the shop checks that you drink alcohol — not a place for non-drinkers (2025 reviews). Changes in numbers must be given by the day before, or ¥7,000 a head is charged; same-day cancellations are billed through a law firm (Tabelog). Cover charge ¥600 + tax (Tabelog). 10 counter seats; parties up to 4; non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). Basement of ヴァインオークトゥエルブ on Oshikoji-dori east of Fuyacho; 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_hikari_yurari.notes: [Italian wine bar · Oshikoji, a hidden basement counter] A ten-seat basement counter near City Hall, with jazz, a glass wine cellar and hams hanging behind the bar: Italian small plates — prosciutto, pâté, an 'adult' potato salad, cheese — cooked by a single chef and matched with Italian wine. Reservation only, for drinkers (non-drinkers are steered away); ¥600 cover. About ¥10,000–15,000 a head. Closed Tuesday and alternate Mondays.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), who runs the kitchen alone (July 2024 review)
chef_bio.background: Per a July 2024 review: in business for 22 years, 12 of them at the present site. Tabelog Italian WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021 and 2023.
chef_bio.specialty: Prosciutto; wine pairing.

anecdotes.text: "Please do not visit if you do not drink alcohol." — June 2025; another June 2025 reviewer says the shop asks about this when you call.
The chef works the kitchen alone and comes across as shy but answers if spoken to — July 2024.
A February 2025 pair found the service somewhat lacking and the portions small for the price, calling it more a wine bar than an Italian restaurant.
The owner explained each dish in detail, with a real passion for pairing — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: hikari-yurari、イタリアン・ワインバー、中京区押小路通麩屋町東入橘町611-1 ヴァインオークトゥエルブ B1F、京都市役所前駅から徒歩5分、月水〜日・祝 18:00〜23:00 (L.O. 料理22:00・ドリンク22:30、最終入店22:00)、火曜と隔週月曜休み、完全予約制、前日までに人数変更の連絡がない場合1人7,000円、当日キャンセルは提携の法律事務所を通じて請求、チャージ600円 (税別)、10席 (カウンターのみ)、禁煙、カード可、イタリアン WEST 百名店 2021・2023。口コミ (2024年7月〜2026年10月、英語): 創業22年・現在地12年 (2024年)、シェフ一人、ジャズ、生ハムの盛り合わせ、パテ、大人のポテトサラダ、チーズ、きのこのコンソメ660円、聖護院かぶのスープ、お酒を飲まない人には向かない。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone; you will be asked if you drink; ¥600 cover; counter only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_hyakkei_tominokoji.gf_detail: Ask. Coffee, tea, beer and two cakes, cheesecake and chocolate cake; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_hyakkei_tominokoji.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee and tea suit; the cakes use dairy and egg (2026 reviews).
kyoto_hyakkei_tominokoji.hours_raw: 14:00–1:00; closed Friday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); often full in the evening, with a short wait or turned away (March–August 2026). 17 seats, counter and tables (Tabelog; March 2026). Smoking allowed at the tables — ashtrays on them — and often smoky (2026 reviews); Tabelog lists a heated-tobacco area. No cards; e-money and PayPay (Tabelog); one August 2026 diner paid cash. Second floor of 山下ビル on Tominokoji just south of Nishiki, behind a bar-like door; 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; March 2026). Opened 10 August 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_hyakkei_tominokoji.notes: [Kissa · Nishiki, a coffee room open until 1 a.m.] Up a flight of stairs off Tominokoji by Nishiki Market and through a door that looks like a bar's, a dim room of concrete walls and yellow light that stays open until one in the morning — rare in Kyoto. Order the Hyakkei blend in mild, medium or strong (¥750) and the soft, rich cheesecake (¥600). It fills up from about nine at night, and smoking is allowed at the tables, so it can be hazy. Closed Friday.

roles: Owner and staff (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 10 August 2019. A March 2026 reviewer thought the room might once have been a bar.
chef_bio.specialty: Hyakkei blend in three roasts; cheesecake.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 visitor at 22:00 on a holiday found it full but got in as others left.
An April 2026 reviewer asked what made the cheesecake so soft; the staff did not know.
A March 2026 visitor found the counter seats uncomfortable for a long stay and the medium roast sold out.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 百景、喫茶店・カフェ、中京区富小路通錦小路下ル西大文字町601 山下ビル 2F、京都河原町駅から344m、14:00〜翌1:00、金曜休み、予約不可、17席、喫煙所 (加熱式たばこのみ)、カード不可、電子マネー・PayPay 可、2019年8月10日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 夜遅くまで開いている喫茶、百景ブレンド750円 (マイルド・ミディアム・ストロング)、ホットオレ850円、チーズケーキ600円、チョコレートケーキ600円、ビール、テーブルで喫煙可、夜は満席が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: No reservations; smoking allowed at the tables; e-money and PayPay.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_ryoriya_otaya.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal kappo dishes with dashi, soy and miso seasonings and heshiko sauce; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ryoriya_otaya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses built on fish and dashi, with crab, hamo, sanma and sea bream (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ryoriya_otaya.hours_raw: Dinner 17:00–22:00, Tuesday–Sunday; lunch 12:00–14:00 on Saturday and Sunday only, booked by the day before; closed Monday and irregularly about twice a month (Tabelog). Reservations advised — easiest between 17:00 and 19:00 (Tabelog). An otoshi of ¥700; no service charge (Tabelog). 16 seats: counter, tables and private rooms for 2–6, some looking onto the Takase River (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Non-smoking, ashtray outside; cards accepted (Tabelog). By the Takase River south of Shijo, 8 min from Kawaramachi Stn, 7 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 25 August 2011 (Tabelog).
kyoto_ryoriya_otaya.notes: [Kappo · Takase River, Kyoto cooking with a Toyama accent] A quiet kappo south of Shijo whose counter and private rooms look out on the Takase River, opened in 2011 by an owner with roots in Toyama — the name recalls a rest-house of the Kaga lords. The eight-dish omakase (¥8,800 in November 2025) moves through the seasons: a 20-ingredient salad, vegetables with a heshiko sauce, hamo and matsutake in autumn, cod milt in winter, with sake from Kyoto and Toyama. Tabelog records eight straight years of a Bib Gourmand. Book ahead; dinner Tuesday–Sunday, lunch at weekends.

roles: Owner (unnamed; roots in Toyama per a November 2025 review)
chef_bio.background: Per a November 2025 review: opened on 25 August 2011; the name Otaya comes from a rest-house used by the Kaga lord for falconry and inspections, chosen for the owner's Toyama roots; the kitchen uses a traditional stove. Tabelog's introduction cites eight consecutive years of a Bib Gourmand and names a sister shop, Ryoriya Toki, opened on the Takase River at Takatsuji by Harada, who worked in Otaya's kitchen. The shop cleans the Takase River and releases fireflies each May (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal omakase; heshiko-sauced vegetables.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 diner noticed the owner explaining every dish carefully to guests from abroad, and found the bill surprisingly modest without alcohol.
An October 2025 regular on a fifth visit called a rare water plant with hairy crab — only four or five pieces from a stalk — the taste of the season.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: りょうりや 御旅屋、日本料理、下京区天満町456-2、阪急河原町駅から徒歩8分、京阪清水五条駅から徒歩7分、火〜日 17:00〜22:00、土日のみ昼12:00〜14:00 (前日までに予約)、月曜休み・月2回不定休、予約可 (17〜19時が比較的取りやすい)、突き出し700円、16席、個室 (2〜6人)、禁煙、カード可、2011年8月25日オープン、ビブグルマン8年連続、姉妹店 Ryoriya Toki (Takatsuji の高瀬川沿い、店主 Harada)、高瀬川の清掃と5月の蛍の放流。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 店主は富山にゆかり、加賀藩の御旅屋に由来する店名、おまかせ8品8,800円、20種の野菜のサラダ、へしこのソース、鱧と松茸の鍋、さんま、白子ポン酢、湯葉と卵の丼、京都と富山の日本酒。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (easiest 17:00–19:00); the owner explains dishes to visitors; ¥700 otoshi.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_itookashi.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled salted salmon with a choice of three seasonings, pot-cooked rice, clam soup and side dishes; the seasonings are not described for gluten (October 2026 reviews).
kyoto_itookashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: set meals of grilled salmon, eel or sashimi with clam soup (October 2026 reviews).
kyoto_itookashi.hours_raw: 7:00–14:30, Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations only, through TableCheck; queues form before opening even with bookings; a 50-minute limit (Tabelog; October 2026). Breakfast at the counter; tables and an upstairs room for other slots (Tabelog; October 2026). A student set at the 7:00 slot ¥1,000 (October 2026). No service charge (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). Smoking allowed per Tabelog. In a machiya on Takatsuji-dori east of Aburanokoji, about 10 min from Shijo Stn (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 2 August 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_itookashi.notes: [Set meals · Takatsuji, the giant grilled salmon breakfast] A machiya with an old tiled kitchen where a fillet of salted salmon so thick it could feed three is grilled on display, then served with glossy pot-cooked rice (refills offered again and again), clam soup and sides — ¥2,500 in October 2026, finished with a pour of dashi. Students eat for ¥1,000 at the 7:00 slot. Bookings only, via TableCheck, and they go fast; even so there is a queue at opening and a 50-minute limit. Lively, kind staff; many visitors from abroad. Monday–Saturday 7:00–14:30.

roles: Operator not named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 2 August 2025. October 2026 reviewers mention it being featured on TV and video sites.
chef_bio.specialty: Thick grilled salted salmon with pot-cooked rice.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner, a little hungover, chose the Kyoto grilled salmon (¥2,500) and found the fillet a battle to finish — enough, it seemed, for three.
An October 2026 student took the ¥1,000 student set at 7:00 — half a fillet plus the collar — and was impressed by the tea served first.
An October 2026 diner wished for more time than the 50-minute limit allowed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都 いとおかし、食堂、下京区高辻通油小路東入永養寺町224、大宮駅から605m、月〜土 7:00〜14:30、日曜休み、予約は TableCheck のみ、朝はカウンターのみ (テーブル席と2階席もある)、サービス料・チャージなし、カード・PayPay 可、英語メニュー、喫煙可、2025年8月2日オープン。口コミ (2026年10月、英語): 分厚い焼き鮭の定食 (味付けは3種から)、京都焼き鮭定食2,500円、Kagoshima の Natsuhonoka の土鍋ご飯 (おかわり自由)、しじみの汁、最後に出汁、7時の学生定食1,000円、ごま鯖、カンパチの刺身、うなぎ、生牡蠣、卵かけご飯、50分制、町家の昔のタイルの台所。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); book on TableCheck; 50-minute seating; many visitors from abroad.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated October 2026.

kyoto_kizahashi_thousand.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal Kyoto courses with dashi, soy and miso (e.g. hoba-yaki with mushroom sauce); no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kizahashi_thousand.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses use dashi and include fish or meat (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kizahashi_thousand.hours_raw: Breakfast 7:00–10:00, lunch 11:30–14:30, dinner 17:30–20:00; closed Tuesday except holidays; hours may change — check the official site (Tabelog). Reservations taken; cancellations from two days before are charged 100% (Tabelog). 15% service charge on the pre-tax bill (Tabelog). 60 seats including a counter, sunken seats and private rooms for 2–12; parties up to 6 at a table; non-smoking, smoking room outside; wheelchair access (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR payments; hotel parking for 50 cars (¥800 per 30 min) (Tabelog). No dress code, though sandals may not be allowed (September 2026). Second floor of THE THOUSAND KYOTO, 2 min east of the JR Kyoto Stn central exit (underground exit 5) (Tabelog).
kyoto_kizahashi_thousand.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Kyoto Station, a hotel restaurant for seasonal courses] The Japanese restaurant on the second floor of THE THOUSAND KYOTO, a two-minute walk from the station, with a calm, spacious room, a counter and private rooms. Seasonal courses start at about ¥10,000 — in autumn 2026 a matsutake soup, hoba-yaki with kinmedai and a mushroom rice you can have refilled — with a sommelier pairing of rare sake and wine. Breakfast and lunch too. Reviewers call it refined and reliable for business meals and family occasions; one found it very much "hotel Japanese". 15% service; closed Tuesday.

roles: Restaurant of THE THOUSAND KYOTO hotel (Tabelog address); chefs not named
chef_bio.background: Tabelog lists it as a hotel restaurant on the second floor of THE THOUSAND KYOTO, with a 15% service charge from 1 April 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal Kyoto courses; refillable seasoned rice.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner chose it for a meeting between a partner and parents and found the service warm and elegant.
A September 2026 diner, worried about portions, took the smallest course (¥10,000) and was too full for a second helping of the mushroom rice.
A September 2026 reviewer described the food as authentic but very much the Japanese cuisine of a hotel.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: KIZAHASHI、日本料理、下京区東塩小路町570 THE THOUSAND KYOTO 2F、JR京都駅中央口から東へ徒歩約2分 (地下通路5番出口)、朝7:00〜10:00、昼11:30〜14:30、夜17:30〜20:00、火曜休み (祝日を除く)、予約可、2日前から100%のキャンセル料、サービス料15% (2025年4月1日から)、60席、個室 (2〜8人、最大12人)、禁煙 (店外に喫煙室)、車いす可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、駐車場50台。口コミ (2026年7〜10月、英語): 季節のコース (秋のコース「Kaze」、松茸と秋鮭の椀、朴葉焼き、きのこご飯)、1万円のコース、ソムリエのペアリング、おかわりできる炊き込みご飯、サンダル不可のことも、ホテルの和食。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel restaurant by Kyoto Station; 15% service; sandals may not be allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_luca_nishiki.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the restaurant states it cannot accommodate wheat allergies (nor dairy, seafood or almond allergies, or vegetarians) (Tabelog). The courses include unlimited bread (April 2025).
kyoto_luca_nishiki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the restaurant states it cannot accommodate vegetarians or dairy allergies (Tabelog); courses centre on seafood, foie gras and wagyu (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_luca_nishiki.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last arrival 12:30), dinner 18:00–22:00 (last arrival 19:00); arrivals after the last order time count as cancellations; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservation only; tell the restaurant about allergies in advance — same-day requests cannot be met, and it cannot accommodate seafood, dairy, wheat or almond allergies, vegetarians, or long lists of exclusions; raw meat or fish can be adjusted only for the main (Tabelog). One drink per person; 8% service on course prices (Tabelog). All guests start together, so do not arrive early (February 2026). A quiet room: diners have been asked to lower their voices (March and July 2025). 8 seats at three small tables, up a staircase with no lift; blankets on request (Tabelog; 2025 reviews). Non-smoking; cards, IC cards, iD and QUICPay (Tabelog). On Tominokoji just north of Nishiki Market; 6 min from Shijo / Karasuma and Kyoto Kawaramachi Stns (Tabelog).
kyoto_luca_nishiki.notes: [French · Nishiki Market, an 8-seat room for long lunches] A high-ceilinged, grey-toned room up a flight of stairs off Tominokoji, with three tables and eight seats, where owner-chef Takuya Sawahara cooks a set course single-handed. Expect a parade of small appetizers, two mains and three desserts — crab with kombu jelly, salmon with oyster cream, Satsuma Nishiki beef — with wine pairings from three to six glasses; dinner was ¥14,700 in late 2025. House rules are firm: book ahead, arrive on time, one drink each, keep your voice down, and no wheat, dairy or vegetarian adjustments. 8% service.

roles: Owner-chef (Tabelog, shop text)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): owner-chef Takuya Sawahara; the name Luca stands for something that brings and gives light. A February 2026 reviewer says the chef trained at renowned Kyoto restaurants and a two-star French restaurant; a July 2026 reviewer says the chef cooks everything from amuse-bouche to dessert alone; an August 2025 regular praises "the chef, and the madam".
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): meals that bring a smile — "the light that spills out when you take a bite."
chef_bio.specialty: Chef’s omakase course; wine pairing.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 birthday diner and another table were reminded several times to lower their voices; the diner took it as the shop protecting its atmosphere.
A March 2025 diner found it a bit intimidating when staff asked another table to keep their voices down mid-explanation.
A November 2025 regular on a fourth yearly visit was recognised a year later with "You got a haircut!"
A July 2026 diner was impressed that the chef handles everything from amuse-bouche to dessert alone, and found the course incredibly satisfying.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: フレンチ、中京区富小路通蛸薬師下ル高宮町585 若葉ビル 2F、四条駅・烏丸駅・京都河原町駅から徒歩6分、エレベーターなし、12:00〜15:00 (L.O. 12:30)・18:00〜22:00 (L.O. 19:00)、遅れた場合はキャンセル扱い、不定休、完全予約制、アレルギーは事前に (当日不可、魚介・乳・小麦・アーモンドのアレルギーやベジタリアンには対応不可)、1人1ドリンク、コースにサービス料8％、8席 (テーブルのみ)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー可、オーナーシェフ Takuya Sawahara、店名は光をもたらすという意味。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年9月、英語): ディナーコース14,700円、ワインペアリング6種10,800円、ランチ7,200円・12,000円、パン食べ放題、京都の名店と二つ星のフレンチで修業、シェフが一人で調理、マダム、声を落とすよう注意されることも、一斉スタート。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; arrive on time; quiet room; one drink each; cards accepted.

staff_allergy_handling.text: The restaurant asks for allergies in advance (no same-day requests) and states it cannot accommodate seafood, dairy, wheat or almond allergies, vegetarians, or many exclusions.

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the shop; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_bussarakan.gf_detail: Ask. Thai dishes such as green curry and tom yum may be wheat-free, but soy and oyster sauces, fried dishes, pad Thai and yakisoba are common; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_bussarakan.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but most dishes use shrimp, chicken, fish sauce or shrimp-based broth (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_bussarakan.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00, dinner 17:00–22:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Riverside platform (kawadoko) seats in summer with an ¥800 charge, no charge indoors (Tabelog; October 2025). 56 seats: an 8-seat counter and 12 sunken seats around an irori downstairs, 36 seats in three private rooms upstairs, 30 on the summer platform (Tabelog). Spice is mild by default; ask for Thai-style heat (November 2025; March 2026). Smoking allowed; cards (Tabelog). In a townhouse on a side alley of Kiyamachi north of Matsubara, by the Kamo River; 6 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_bussarakan.notes: [Thai · Kiyamachi-Matsubara, Thai food in a Kyoto townhouse by the river] A Thai restaurant in an old townhouse down a side alley off Kiyamachi, with an irori counter, tatami rooms upstairs looking at the Kamo River, and a riverside platform in summer (¥800 charge). Lunch sets of gapao or green curry are good value; dinner courses bring tom yum kung, pad Thai and green curry, or order à la carte — tom kha gai, khao soi, som tum. Spice is gentle unless you ask for Thai heat. A Japanese owner fronts the house with a Thai chef, per one reviewer. No bookings; closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner (unnamed) with a Thai chef, per an August 2026 review
chef_bio.background: An August 2026 reviewer describes a combination of traditional Japanese service by the owner and a Thai chef; a January 2026 reviewer was welcomed by a friendly master. Reviewers note the seasoning is adjusted for Japanese tastes, with authentic heat on request.
chef_bio.specialty: Tom yum kung; green curry; khao soi.

anecdotes.text: "The menu mentions that if you ask for a spicier Thai-style dish, they can make it hotter." — November 2025.
An April 2026 diner found the portions a little small for sharing but the tom yum kung excellent.
A March 2026 diner was pleased the kitchen swapped a ginger chicken stir-fry for Thai-style kara-age.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: タイ料理・創作料理・居酒屋、下京区木屋町通松原上ル美濃屋町173-1、阪急京都河原町駅1番出口から徒歩6分、月火木金土日 11:30〜15:00・17:00〜22:00、水曜休み、予約不可、56席 (1階カウンター8、囲炉裏の掘りごたつ12、2階36席・個室3、夏の床30席)、喫煙可、カード可、ベジタリアンメニューあり。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年9月、英語): 町家のタイ料理、鴨川沿い、床席は800円のチャージ、ガパオのランチ、トムヤムクン、グリーンカレー、パッタイ、カオソーイ、トムカーガイ、ヤムウンセン、辛さは控えめで本場の辛さも可、日本人の店主とタイ人の料理人。

cultural_comfort.note: No bookings; ask for Thai-style heat if you want it; cards accepted; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_kaikado_cafe.gf_detail: Ask. Cheesecakes and toast are wheat-based; karaki mochi and red-bean sweets may not be, but no ingredient lists are published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kaikado_cafe.vegan_detail: Ask. Teas and black coffee suit; the cheesecakes use cheese, and other sweets are not described ingredient by ingredient (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kaikado_cafe.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 8:00–16:00; Saturday and Sunday 8:00–17:00 (Tabelog); a September 2026 visitor found it closes early. Reservations accepted (Tabelog); a reviewer’s friend booked the upstairs room (September 2026). 31 seats: 14 at tables, 7 at the counter, 10 on the terrace (no smoking there either) (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX), e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). Tea caddies and crafts on display and for sale (2026 reviews). On Kawaramachi-dori north of Shichijo, a bus stop to Kyoto Station in front; 320 m from Shichijo Stn (Tabelog; August 2026).
kyoto_kaikado_cafe.notes: [Café · Shichijo, tea-caddy maker's café in an old tram building] The café of Kaikado, the venerable Kyoto maker of hand-made tea caddies, in a registered cultural property that reviewers describe as a former streetcar building near Shichijo: high ceilings, big windows, wooden shelves of caddies for sale. Try the Kaikado cheesecake shaped like a caddy (set ¥2,050), the seasonal tea with karaki mochi (¥1,700, second steep included) or an early-morning an toast — it opens at 8:00. Drinks are priced high; the room is calm.

roles: Café of the tea-caddy maker Kaikado; no staff named
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a café run by Kaikado, a long-established Kyoto tea-caddy maker, in a nearly 100-year-old Western-style building registered as a tangible cultural property and renovated from an old streetcar depot (August–October 2026). Tabelog Cafe WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Kaikado cheesecake; seasonal tea with karaki mochi.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor found the ¥1,150 cold brew pricey for a standard glass and its taste close to a well-known chain’s.
A September 2026 visitor waited a long time between a companion’s order and the reviewer’s, so the coffee went cool.
"The excitement of opening the tea canister was irresistible!" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、下京区河原町通七条上ル住吉町352、七条駅から320m、月〜金 8:00〜16:00、土日 8:00〜17:00、予約可、31席 (テーブル14、カウンター7、テラス10、テラスも禁煙)、カード (JCB・AMEX)・電子マネー・QR 可、カフェ WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2026年7〜10月、英語): 茶筒の Kaikado のカフェ、登録有形文化財の建物、市電の車庫を改装、Kaikado チーズケーキ (Nasu の高原のチーズ) のセット2,050円、Karaki Mochi と季節のお茶のセット1,700円、水出しコーヒー1,150円、アイスコーヒー950円、カフェオレ、抹茶ラテ、あんトースト、茶筒に入ったセット、早く閉まる。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the table; tea caddies for sale; cards (JCB, AMEX) and QR accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026; Cafe WEST Tabelog 100 2025.

kyoto_agotsuyu_yamafuku.gf_detail: Ask. The broth is grilled flying-fish dashi with soy milk, the dipping sauce is dashi-based, and the courses finish with Chinese-style noodles or soba; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_agotsuyu_yamafuku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork and beef shabu-shabu in flying-fish broth (2026 reviews).
kyoto_agotsuyu_yamafuku.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00 daily; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, online or by phone; a two-hour limit on all seats; bookings lapse 15 minutes after the time without notice (Tabelog); walk-ins can find it full (August 2026). Shoes off at the entrance; many steps inside, so guests with mobility issues should take note (Tabelog). 36 seats at a counter, sofas, tatami and sunken tables; private rooms; non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). Staff spoke English to overseas guests (October 2026). Down an alley on Kiyamachi south of Sanjo, toward Pontocho; 5 min from Sanjo and Kyoto Kawaramachi Stns (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_agotsuyu_yamafuku.notes: [Shabu-shabu · Kiyamachi, pork in flying-fish broth] A shoes-off shabu-shabu house down an alley off Kiyamachi near Sanjo, where a whole grilled flying fish flavours the broth before soy milk goes in. Swish three meats — mochi pork belly, 'Baumkuchen' pork loin and A5 Omi beef — with plenty of free white leek, then finish with custom noodles and Gion Tsujiri matcha ice cream. Courses run ¥5,250–9,000, some with free-flow drinks. Young, chatty staff, English spoken. Two-hour limit; open daily 17:00–24:00.

roles: Restaurant; no staff named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe young, friendly, humorous staff, English spoken with overseas guests (October 2026), and noodles made to order by a long-established Kyoto soba shop (August 2026). Tabelog Hot Pot "Tabelog 100" 2024.
chef_bio.specialty: Agotsuyu pork shabu-shabu.

anecdotes.text: "The staff had a great sense of humor. I won’t say too much to avoid spoilers." — August 2026.
An October 2026 diner arriving at 21:30 found every other guest was from overseas and the staff speaking English.
An October 2026 diner found the portions a little small but everything delicious.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: しゃぶしゃぶ・豚しゃぶ・居酒屋、中京区木屋町通三条下る材木町187、阪急河原町駅・京阪三条駅・祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、毎日17:00〜24:00、不定休、予約可 (全席2時間制、連絡なく15分遅れるとキャンセル扱い)、入口で靴を脱ぐ、店内は段差が多い、36席、個室、禁煙、カード可、すき焼き・しゃぶしゃぶ百名店 2024。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 焼いたあご (飛魚) の出汁と豆乳のしゃぶしゃぶ、Mochi Pork のバラ、Club Harie のバウムクーヘンで育った豚のロース、Omi の A5 の牛、白ねぎは好きなだけ、老舗のそば屋の特製の中華麺、Gion Tsujiri の抹茶アイス、コース5,250円・6,000円・6,500円・9,000円、英語で対応、若くにぎやかなスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff spoke English with overseas guests (October 2026); shoes off; cards accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_oicho.gf_detail: Ask. Chicken cuts are grilled at the table with salt, sauce or yuzu pepper; the menu also has kushiage, spring rolls, takana fried rice and ponzu dishes; no gluten information is published (Tabelog menu, March 2026; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_oicho.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the menu centres on chicken, and the hot pot uses chicken-bone and kombu dashi (Tabelog; Tabelog menu, March 2026).
kyoto_oicho.hours_raw: 18:00–24:00; closed Wednesday, but open on Wednesdays before and on holidays (Tabelog). Bookings taken; mention children’s ages; the hot pot needs a booking (Tabelog; April 2026). Table charge ¥330 a head, none for children of elementary age and under (Tabelog). Raw chicken (tataki yukke) to be eaten within 30 minutes of serving (February 2025). 30 seats (9 at the counter, 21 at tables); non-smoking, ashtray outside the door; cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). On Teramachi south of Takatsuji; 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_oicho.notes: [Chicken · Teramachi-Takatsuji, grill-your-own chicken on charcoal] A busy chicken house on Teramachi south of Takatsuji where you order Kyotanba chicken by the cut — thigh, harami, neck, liver, heart — and grill it yourself on a charcoal shichirin, yakiniku-style. Start with the five-kind sashimi platter or the rare tataki yukke, and don't skip the chicken-and-cream-cheese spring rolls. Cuts from ¥430; a one-person salt hot pot (¥1,880) needs booking. Reviewers praise the friendly staff; on busy nights service can be slow. Open to midnight; closed Wednesday.

roles: No person is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: A sister shop, 鶏焼肉はやし おいちょ, appears in the Tabelog crawl. Reviewers describe a friendly, engaging chef (January 2025) and attentive staff (2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Grill-your-own Kyotanba chicken; chicken sashimi; cream-cheese spring rolls.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 diner was told to eat the chicken tataki yukke within 30 minutes of serving.
A March 2026 diner was asked about dislikes before the five-cut grilled platter came.
An April 2026 diner was warned dishes would take time on a crowded night and could not order the hot pot without a booking.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鳥料理・居酒屋、下京区寺町通高辻下ル京極町497-2、阪急河原町駅から徒歩5分、月・火・木〜日 18:00〜24:00、水曜休み (祝前日・祝日は営業)、予約可 (子供の年齢も)、付き出し1人330円 (小学生以下はなし)、30席 (カウンター9、テーブル21)、禁煙 (入口外に灰皿)、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、ベジタリアンメニューあり、メニュー (英語版、2026年3月更新): 京丹波の鶏の炭火焼き (もも630円、むね470円、ハラミ550円、せせり550円、ささみ550円、皮470円、レバー520円、砂肝630円、ハツ520円、ぼんじり430円、やげん軟骨520円)、京丹波鶏の塩鍋 (一人用水炊き) 1,880円、串揚げ10本1,320円。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年11月、英語): 七輪で自分で焼く、鶏刺し盛り合わせ、鶏たたきユッケ、ささみとクリームチーズの生春巻き、しそつくね、高菜炒飯、飲み放題コース5,500円。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (the hot pot needs a booking); you grill the chicken yourself; raw chicken on the menu.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (menu March 2026); reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_hakoniwa_bistro_bar.gf_detail: Ask. A meat-and-drinks bistro bar: roast-beef bowls with dashi soy sauce, sausages, kara-age, fries, French toast and pancakes; no gluten information is published (Tabelog menu, September 2026; 2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_hakoniwa_bistro_bar.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat bowls, BBQ, meat hot pot, kara-age and egg dishes make up the menu (Tabelog menu; 2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_hakoniwa_bistro_bar.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–16:00, then 16:00–24:00 (last order 23:00) Monday to Saturday, and to 22:00 (last order 21:30) Sundays and holidays; Tabelog also notes 16:00–24:00 in summer and 16:00–22:00 in winter; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Bookings via TableCheck or phone; same-day by phone only, even when online shows full (Tabelog). Rooftop terrace: ¥500 a head unless on a course (Tabelog); summer beer garden and BBQ courses from April; kotatsu seats with hot pot from November to March (Tabelog menu; 2024–26 reviews). Two-hour seating on the all-you-can-drink courses (October 2025). 13 seats inside (5 at the counter, two tables) plus the terrace, up to 20 guests; designated smoking area; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). On the 4th floor (B) of the 大西ビル; 3 min from Sanjo Stn, 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 26 February 2018 (Tabelog).
kyoto_hakoniwa_bistro_bar.notes: [Bistro bar · Sanjo-Gion, a rooftop terrace for every season] A small fourth-floor bistro bar between Sanjo and Gion-Shijo whose real draw is its rooftop terrace over the city: a beer garden and BBQ courses in the warm months, and kotatsu tables with a meat hot pot from November to March. By day there are roast-beef NIKU bowls you finish as chazuke and French toast made with Uji-tea-fed eggs. Reviewers like the view, the friendly owner and the value; some found the hot pot mild and, in May 2026, the sodas flat. ¥500 terrace charge unless on a course. Open from noon.

roles: Owner (unnamed); an August 2026 reviewer found the owner very friendly
chef_bio.background: Opened 26 February 2018 (Tabelog). The rooftop terrace turns into kotatsu seating with blankets and hand warmers for winter (December 2024; November 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: NIKU bowl; rooftop BBQ; winter kotatsu hot pot.

anecdotes.text: A December 2024 group was given a large blanket and disposable hand warmers at the group’s rooftop kotatsu.
A May 2026 diner found the rooftop view excellent and the meat decent, but the sodas almost flat.
A May 2026 diner who left something behind called the next day and was kindly helped.

kyoto_kameya_mutsu.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the signature matsukaze is made of wheat flour, sugar, malt syrup and white miso (official site).
kyoto_kameya_mutsu.vegan_detail: Ask. The matsukaze’s listed ingredients are wheat flour, sugar, malt syrup and white miso, with poppy seeds; the rakugan 憶昔 is sugar, white bean paste, rice flour, wasanbon, hama-natto and cinnamon (official site) — none lists animal products, but ask.
kyoto_kameya_mutsu.hours_raw: 8:30–17:00; closed Wednesday and 1–3 January (official site; Tabelog). Takeaway only (Tabelog). Seasonal sweets (fresh wagashi, warabi-mochi, mizu-yokan, manju) are sold only at this main shop (official site). Matsukaze is also sold at Nishi Hongan-ji’s shops, Kyoto Takashimaya, JR Kyoto Isetan and station shops (official site). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Opposite Nishi Hongan-ji, north of Shichijo on Nishinakasuji-dori, by the Shichijo-Horikawa bus stop; about 12 min walk from Kyoto Stn (official site).
kyoto_kameya_mutsu.notes: [Wagashi · Nishi Hongan-ji, the matsukaze of a 600-year-old confectioner] An old confectioner opposite Nishi Hongan-ji that by its own history has supplied the temple's offerings since 1421. Its famous 松風 is a chewy, bread-like slab of fermented wheat dough, white miso and malt syrup, baked in a huge pan and scattered with poppy seeds — said to have started as siege rations in the 石山合戦, and named from a poem by 顕如. Eight pieces ¥700; cut-end bags are a bargain. Seasonal wagashi are sold only here. Takeaway only; 8:30–17:00, closed Wednesday.

roles: 株式会社亀屋陸奥 (founded as a company in 1964; official site); no person is named in the sources read
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded, by tradition, in 1421; supplier of offerings to Hongan-ji from about the time 蓮如 (Rennyo) led it; during the 石山合戦 (from 1570) a sweet first made as rations became matsukaze, named after 顕如’s poem once Hongan-ji settled at 六条堀川 (1591); around 1660 the house received a cypress turtle said to have floated in Hideyoshi’s Jurakudai pond, the 亀 of its name, and in 1715 the title 陸奥大掾 from the court; matsukaze specimens won silver at the 1900 Paris Exposition; incorporated in 1964. 司馬遼太郎 wrote matsukaze into 『燃えよ剣』 and 『関ヶ原』. Tabelog Wagashi WEST "Tabelog 100" 2026 (official site news, 29 September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to keep the taste handed down since the Warring States period and pass it on to the next era, one sheet at a time.
chef_bio.specialty: 松風; 憶昔; seasonal wagashi.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor found the shop closed on its Wednesday holiday and bought matsukaze inside Nishi Hongan-ji instead.
An October 2026 buyer of the value bag found about 20 pieces, including broken ones — "quite a bargain".
A September 2026 visitor noticed a steady stream of local customers buying gifts.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kameyamutsu.jp): 1421年創業、京都・西本願寺前の老舗和菓子店 亀屋陸奥、本願寺御用達の御供物司、応永28年 (1421年) 創業と伝わる、蓮如上人のころから御供物の調達、石山合戦の籠城の中で松風の原型、1591年に本願寺が六条堀川へ移り「松風」と名づけられる (顕如上人の歌)、1660年頃に豊臣秀吉ゆかりの檜造りの亀を拝領、1715年に「陸奥大掾」の御宣旨、1900年パリ万国博覧会で銀賞、1964年に株式会社亀屋陸奥、松風は小麦粉、砂糖、麦芽飴、白味噌を自然発酵させ、直径約45.5cm の一文字鍋で焼きケシの実を振る、西六條寺内松風 (浜納豆)、徳用袋、憶昔 (落雁)、滴翠 (麩焼煎餅)、季節のお菓子は本店のみ、下京区西中筋通七条上る菱屋町153、8:30〜17:00 (水曜日定休)、七条堀川バス停前、京都駅から徒歩約12分、取扱店舗: 西本願寺売店、京都高島屋、JR京都伊勢丹ほか、2026年9月29日 食べログ 和菓子・甘味処 WEST 百名店 2026 選出。食べログ: 和菓子、テイクアウトのみ、1月1日〜3日休み、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2026年6〜10月、英語): 松風8枚700円、もなか220円、徳用袋。

cultural_comfort.note: Takeaway counter; matsukaze also sold inside Nishi Hongan-ji.

Bookings online or by phone (official site). Private room ¥2,200 a head; a 10% service charge from 1 December 2026 (Tabelog). Smart casual (no shorts, tank tops or sports sandals for men); shoes off — bring socks if barefoot; children only if they can eat the adult course (Tabelog). 14 seats: a 10-seat counter and a private room for 4; non-smoking; cards accepted (Tabelog). Takeaway saba-zushi and other omotase (official site). By taxi, say 高倉万寿寺; 5 min from Gojo Stn exit 1 (official site; Tabelog).
kyoto_yokoi.notes: [Kaiseki · Takakura-Manjuji, a Michelin star in a 180-year-old townhouse] A 14-seat kappo in a renovated 180-year-old townhouse south of Shijo, opened in 2023 by a chef who spent 12 years in the Kodaiji Wakuden group and ran the kitchen at 二条やま岸; it gained a Michelin star in the 2026 guide. Seasonal Kyoto courses at the counter — lunch about ¥15,000–17,000, dinner about ¥30,000 with drinks. Shoes off; smart casual. Closed Monday.

roles: 店主 (owner) per the official site, which romanises the name "Yokoi Yushi"; Tabelog’s operator text calls the chef "Hiroshi Yokoi"
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: from 18 trained for 12 years in shops of the 高台寺和久傳 group; head chef of 二条やま岸 at 32; independent at 36 near Karasuma-Gojo; listed in the Michelin Guide from 2023 and awarded one star in the Michelin Guide Kyoto–Osaka 2026. Opened 1 December 2023 (Tabelog). Reviews differ on who the owner is: several 2026 reviewers describe a woman owner who welcomes guests alongside the head chef, and a July 2026 reviewer writes that the owner and the head chef are business partners, not a couple.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the operator’s Tabelog text: "Koufuku" — food happiness — from the first bite to the swallow; to leave guests with warm memories.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kaiseki; saba-zushi.

anecdotes.text: A late-June 2026 lunch guest at the counter enjoyed the sound of the chef filleting hamo.
A July 2026 lunch guest (¥17,000 with a highball) found several later dishes — turtle, sashimi, hand-rolled sushi — lacking distinct flavour.
A guest who missed a Shinkansen and arrived very late was still warmly welcomed — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyo-yokoi.com): よこい、店主 横井裕史 (Yokoi Yushi)、18歳から高台寺和久傳グループの店舗にて12年間研鑽、32歳で二条やま岸料理長、36歳で京都烏丸五条にて独立、ミシュランガイド2023から掲載継続、ミシュランガイド京都・大阪2026で1つ星、昼 12:00〜15:00 (水・木・土・日)、夜 18:00〜22:00 (入店は18時か19時)、月曜定休、おもたせ (鯖寿司、きんぴら鮭弁当、湯葉ちりめん山椒)、下京区万寿寺中之町88、タクシーでは「高倉万寿寺」。食べログ: 日本料理、五条駅1番出口から徒歩5分、14席 (カウンター10、個室4)、個室料1人2,200円、2026年12月1日からサービス料10%、スマートカジュアル、靴を脱いで入店、大人と同じコースを食べられる子どものみ、カード可、禁煙、2023年12月1日オープン、築180年の京町家、横井裕史シェフ。口コミ (2026年6〜10月、英語): 蓮の葉のトマトのジュレ、帆立と甘海老と桃のジュレとキャビア、鮑の天ぷら、鱧、鮎、ランチ1万5千〜1万7千円、女性の店主と料理長。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online; shoes off; smart casual; tell the taxi 高倉万寿寺.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026; Michelin one star 2026 (official site).

kyoto_onn_wagashi.gf_detail: Ask. Creative wagashi built on daifuku (rice-flour mochi) with fillings such as rum raisin, Earl Grey, chestnut and osmanthus, and kakigori with kinako, shiratama and job’s tears; no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_onn_wagashi.vegan_detail: Ask. Wagashi are bean-, rice- and chestnut-based, but some kakigori come with fresh cream or milk and the latte uses milk; no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_onn_wagashi.hours_raw: 11:00–18:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog). No reservations: write your name and number at the door and they call when a seat is free, asking you to come within about 10 minutes; waits of up to two hours in summer 2026, while solo guests and weekday visitors were sometimes seated at once (Tabelog; August–October 2026). Order at the counter by the entrance first (August 2026). 13 seats; non-smoking; no table charge (Tabelog). Cards, transport IC, iD and QUICPay (Tabelog). Takeaway sweets sold at the front (2026 reviews). 6 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn exit 9 (Tabelog). Opened 16 November 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_onn_wagashi.notes: [Wagashi café · Kawaramachi, matcha in a townhouse] A calm, much-queued tea room in a renovated townhouse with a small garden seen through a round window, serving seasonal creative wagashi on a daifuku base — rum-raisin "Ajisai", chestnut "Yamato Kuri", osmanthus with cinnamon — with matcha whisked before you in a bowl you pick from a shelf of handmade pottery. Summer brings kakigori such as hojicha with kinako espuma or rich Wazuka matcha (¥1,870). No bookings: leave your number and they call. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who chose the pottery (October 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened 16 November 2023 (Tabelog). An October 2026 reviewer calls it "onn Kyoto Gion-cho", a renovated Kyoto townhouse with a small garden through a round window and handcrafted pottery chosen by the owner; reviewers in August–October 2026 describe long summer waits, staff who are pleasant, and a shop seen on Instagram.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal creative wagashi; hojicha kakigori.

anecdotes.text: "I saw a sign saying there was a 2-hour wait. I hesitated but decided to go in and made a reservation by writing my name and phone number." The call came about an hour later. — August 2026.
"The Ajisai had a striking flavor of rum raisin, which is a unique combination not often found in wagashi." — September 2026.
"You can also choose your matcha bowl, so be sure to pick your favorite; mine is the camellia bowl." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 甘味処・和菓子、中京区伊勢屋町341-1、阪急京都河原町駅9番出口から徒歩6分、11:00〜18:00、火・水曜休み、予約不可、13席、禁煙、チャージなし、カード・交通系IC・iD・QUICPay 可、2023年11月16日オープン。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 入口で名前と電話番号を書いて呼び出し、夏は2時間待ち、入口のカウンターで先に注文、大福が基本の創作和菓子 (Ajisai のラムレーズン、Yamato Kuri、アールグレイ、金木犀とシナモン)、選べる抹茶碗、目の前で点てる抹茶、ほうじ茶のかき氷ときな粉のエスプーマ、Wazuka の抹茶のかき氷1,870円、町家と丸窓の坪庭、持ち帰りの和菓子は1個400円ほど。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter by the door; leave a name and number when there is a wait; cards and IC accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_oogami_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Omakase kaiseki with dashi soups, sashimi, vinegared miso dishes, simmered and grilled courses and kamameshi; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_oogami_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the kaiseki is built on fish, shellfish, hamo, eel and dashi (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_oogami_gion.hours_raw: Lunch from 11:30, dinner from 17:00, all guests starting together; allow about two hours for lunch and three for dinner; closed Thursday (Tabelog; February 2025). Reservation only, for two or more (Tabelog); lunch is hard to book (August 2025). Lunch ¥6,500 per Tabelog, ¥7,000 in February 2026; service included; cash only (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Dress smartly (Tabelog). 9 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). In a back alley of Gion north of Shijo, ground floor of サカタビル; 8 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; September 2025).
kyoto_oogami_gion.notes: [Kaiseki · Gion, a nine-seat counter of many small dishes] A nine-seat counter in a Gion back alley where Mr. Oogami, cooking here for about 30 years with an apprentice, sends out a stream of small seasonal dishes in beautiful tableware — two hours at lunch, three at dinner, everyone starting together. Lunch at ¥6,500–7,000 is the famous bargain and hard to book; the leftover kamameshi comes wrapped as rice balls to take home. The chef looks stern but is chatty and funny. Cash only; book for two or more; dress smartly; closed Thursday.

roles: Owner-chef (May 2024 review: "The owner, Mr. Oogami"), with an apprentice (July 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per a May 2024 review: kaiseki in Gion for about 30 years; the owner, Mr. Oogami, is meticulous and serves an astonishing variety of dishes, with the menu changing monthly; the restaurant was shown on the TV programme "Hayashi’s Nippon Drill" on 23 January 2019 as a favourite of Hayashi Osamu (also March 2025). Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a chef who looks intimidating but is friendly and entertaining, and who shared a beer with guests and the apprentice (July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase kaiseki of many small dishes; kamameshi.

anecdotes.text: "At the end, they offered to wrap the kamameshi in bamboo leaves as an onigiri to take home" — September 2025.
"What surprised me was how entertaining the head chef was." The lunch course lasted about two hours. — August 2025.
A July 2026 diner, alone with the chef and the apprentice at 17:00, shared a bottle of Asahi — the chef’s favourite — and toasted with both.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、東山区末吉町88 サカタビル1階、河原町駅から8分、昼11:30〜・夜17:00〜 (昼は約2時間、夜は約3時間)、木曜休み、完全予約制 (2名から)、昼6,500円、サービス料込み、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、ドレスコード、9席 (カウンター)、禁煙。口コミ (2024年5月〜2026年7月、英語): 祇園で約30年の会席、店主の Oogami さん、毎月変わる献立、美しい器、Hayashi Osamu の番組 (2019年1月)、昼のコース6,500〜7,000円、全員一斉スタート、釜飯を葉で包んだおにぎりの持ち帰り、見た目は怖いが気さくで面白い大将、弟子、アサヒの瓶ビール、シャブリのハーフボトル。

cultural_comfort.note: Book for two or more; fixed start time; cash only; smart dress.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_iharada.gf_detail: Ask. Kaiseki courses with sushi, a fried dish, miso-marinated items and red miso soup; no gluten information (official menu; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_iharada.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses include hamo, soft-shelled turtle, crab, aged Tajima beef and dashi throughout (official menu; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_iharada.hours_raw: 17:30–22:00, last entry 20:00; closed Sunday (official site); Tabelog adds irregular closures and opening on holidays that fall on Sunday. Reservations by phone or TableCheck; same-day cancellations are charged 100% (official site; Tabelog). Courses ¥12,000, ¥15,000, ¥20,000 before tax and 10% service (¥14,520, ¥18,150, ¥24,200 all-in) (official site). Children from elementary-school age, eating the adult course (official site). A 6 m single-plank hinoki counter of 9–10 seats and a second-floor room for 2–20; non-smoking at the table, with a smoking corner (official site; Tabelog). Cards accepted (official site). On Nishioji-dori 150 m north of Shichijo, west side; 1 min from the Nishioji-Shichijo bus stop, about 10 min by taxi from Kyoto Stn (official site). Opened 5 October 2002 (Tabelog).
kyoto_iharada.notes: [Kaiseki · Nishioji-Shichijo, aged beef and the house farm] A white, modern kaiseki house on Nishioji, a short taxi ride from Kyoto Station, with a 6 m single-plank hinoki counter and calligraphy on the walls: 10–11 courses of morning-market fish, vegetables from its own Ohara farm and carcass-aged Tajima beef, with the hassun served mid-course, mackerel sushi, soft-shelled turtle and an ice-cream monaka to finish. Courses ¥14,520–24,200 all-in. Regulars return for years; one March 2026 diner felt rushed by the schedule. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner-chef and okami (unnamed on the pages read)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: fish bought at the market every morning; vegetables grown at いはら田農園 in Ohara; aged Tajima beef specially bought from 中勢似, carcass-aged on the bone; calligraphy by 山田秋邨 throughout the white interior; a greeting from the okami on its fifteenth year; press from 2003 (All About Japan, Gainer) to 2008 (あまから手帖). Opened 5 October 2002 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe the head chef seeing guests off (March 2026), an eight-time regular (February 2026), and an earlier complaint about the pace that a December 2025 diner found fixed.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: traditional yet innovative "new washoku", with the cook free to combine whatever the season allows.
chef_bio.specialty: Aged Tajima beef; mackerel sushi; hassun.

anecdotes.text: "This time, both the atmosphere and the pace have changed dramatically … and I was very satisfied." — December 2025.
"I also love the ice cream monaka that they serve for dessert here." — April 2026.
A March 2026 diner who arrived late had to rush the meal to fit the restaurant’s schedule.
"The top sirloin, aged for two months, allowed me to fully enjoy the rich taste of the red meat." — November 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (iharada.jp): 御料理 いはら田、下京区西七条比輪田町26 (西大路七条上る150m西側)、17:30〜22:00 (最終入店20:00)、日曜定休、カウンター9席と2Fの個室 (2〜20名)、喫煙コーナーあり、カード可、毎朝市場で仕入れる魚、大原のいはら田農園の野菜、熟成但馬牛のヒレ (中勢似から仕入れる枝肉熟成)、鱧、すっぽん、松茸、カニ、長さ6mの一枚板の檜のカウンター、書道家 山田秋邨の書、女将のごあいさつ、コース12,000円 (税サ込14,520円)・15,000円 (18,150円)・20,000円 (24,200円)、約10〜11品、当日キャンセルは100%、小学生以上、メディア掲載 (2003〜2008年)、TableCheck。食べログ (店舗会員): 日本料理、月〜土 17:30〜22:00、日曜 (祝日除く)・不定休、30席 (1階カウンター10、2階テーブル20)、サービス料10%、禁煙、2002年10月5日オープン。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年11月、英語): 鯖寿司と鮪の握り、すっぽん鍋、八寸、熟成肉、アイス最中、急かされたとの声 (2026年3月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English and Chinese pages on the official site; book via TableCheck; tell the taxi "Nishioji Shichijo, 150 m north".

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing (staff-maintained); reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_en_hachijo.gf_detail: Ask. À la carte kappo: sashimi, tempura and fried dishes, nama-fu dengaku, miso-marinated scallops, mackerel sushi, duck and truffle noodles; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_en_hachijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, fish, meat and dashi dishes; even the appetiser has yuba with dashi jelly (2026 reviews).
kyoto_en_hachijo.hours_raw: 17:30–23:00, Monday to Saturday; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and needed — reviewers took three to five tries to get in; many regulars (Tabelog; June–September 2026). An appetiser charge of about ¥900, varying with the season (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). 12 seats: a counter and one table; non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2026). A small, easy-to-miss sign; two doors from a Daily Yamazaki, 5 min walk from Kyoto Stn’s Hachijo exit — Tabelog warns that Google Maps puts it in the wrong place (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 18 April 2013 (Tabelog).
kyoto_en_hachijo.notes: [Kappo · Kyoto Station Hachijo, an à la carte counter] A 12-seat counter a few minutes south of Kyoto Station, behind a sign so small that Tabelog warns Google Maps has it wrong: one of the few Kyoto counters where you order à la carte, from a long seasonal list — sashimi with sea urchin and toro, ayu grilled before you, white shrimp and lily-bulb tempura, simmered kinmedai, duck and truffle noodles. The owner's warm, careful service is praised as much as the food. Bills about ¥9,000–15,000; cash only; book well ahead. Closed Sunday.

roles: Chef and owner (a woman, front of house), unnamed in the sources
chef_bio.background: Opened 18 April 2013 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe a chef working in view across the counter, an owner whose attentive service and choice of words they single out, and women staff who are kind from the moment of booking; many regulars, and bookings that take several tries.
chef_bio.specialty: À la carte seasonal plates; sashimi; tempura.

anecdotes.text: "After trying three times, I finally managed to make a reservation." The menu marks dishes suited to solo diners. — June 2026.
A July 2026 diner most wanted to stress the owner’s service — exceptionally attentive, with impressive choice of words — and paid ¥9,200 for one.
"Finally got to the restaurant I've always wanted to visit! … it was my fifth attempt!" — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、南区東九条西山王町15-2、京都駅八条口から5分、Daily Yamazaki の2軒隣 (Google マップの位置は違う)、月〜土 17:30〜23:00、日曜休み、予約可、お通し約900円 (季節変動)、12席、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、禁煙、2013年4月18日オープン。口コミ (2026年6〜10月、英語): アラカルトのカウンター、お造りの盛り合わせ (しまあじ、いさき、ウニ、Biwa trout、トロ)、鱧、目の前で焼く鮎、白海老と百合根の天ぷら、金目鯛の煮付け、鴨とトリュフの麺、鯖寿司、生麩田楽、一人客向けの印、常連が多い、予約に3〜5回、女将の気配り、1人9,000〜15,000円ほど。

cultural_comfort.note: À la carte Japanese menu at a small counter; book by phone well ahead; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_gaya_gaya.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the menu mixes quiche, baguettes, pasta and ajillo with Japanese small plates (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gaya_gaya.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information; dishes seen include yuba and sesame tofu but mostly meat and fish — horse sashimi, Ezo venison, duck confit, swordfish (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gaya_gaya.hours_raw: Tabelog: every day 17:30–4:30 (food last order 3:30, drinks 4:15); open through New Year’s Eve and Day, though 1–3 January it closes at 1:00 (last order 24:00). Reservations by phone 10:00–3:00; private hire for 11 or more (Tabelog). Courses with all-you-can-drink (2024–2025 reviews). 16 seats: 6 at the counter, 10 at tables; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Cards and QR payments, no e-money (Tabelog). 3F of the 佐野ビル, east off Kawaramachi south of Sanjo along the BAL north street; 4 min walk from Keihan Sanjo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_gaya_gaya.notes: [Dining bar · Kawaramachi-Sanjo, one man till dawn] A 16-seat dining bar up on a third floor off Kawaramachi, run single-handed by its owner and open until 4:30 every night: a long menu of small plates — duck confit (¥1,100), quiche, venison, horse sashimi, conger-eel ajillo — and well-made cocktails, with all-you-can-drink courses for groups. Reviewers praise the speed and value. Smoking allowed. 17:30–4:30 daily.

roles: Owner (unnamed) who runs the bar alone, per 2024–2025 reviews
chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2024 to 2025 describe a one-man operation — the owner cooks, mixes drinks and serves — with dishes arriving quickly despite a wide menu; an April 2025 diner found the owner a big anime fan who loves to chat, and an August 2025 diner discovered the master was a senior from the same university.
chef_bio.specialty: Duck confit; quiche; cocktails.

anecdotes.text: A diner who comes back once a year for the ¥1,100 duck confit compares it to a ¥4,000 dish at a fine-dining restaurant — September 2026.
"Still a one-man operation, with a wide menu and absolutely delicious!" — September 2024.
An August 2025 group found the master was a senior from their university and spent the course reminiscing.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・バー・ダイニングバー、中京区河原町通三条下ルBAL北通り東入ル北側北車屋町267 佐野ビル 3F、毎日17:30〜翌4:30 (L.O. 料理3:30・ドリンク4:15)、年末年始も営業 (1月1〜3日は24:00 L.O.、25:00閉店)、電話予約は10:00〜3:00、11名以上で貸切、16席 (カウンター6、テーブル10)、喫煙可、カード・QR 可、電子マネー不可、飲み放題・コースあり。口コミ (2024年1月〜2026年9月、英語): 鴨のコンフィ1,100円、キッシュ、カジキのベルモットソース、ささみのカルパッチョ明太子ソース、湯葉と胡麻豆腐、馬刺しのルイベ、蝦夷鹿のロースト、穴子のアヒージョ、蟹のパスタ、店主ひとりで営業。

cultural_comfort.note: A small late-night bar run by one person; book a course for groups; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_kichizaemon_gion.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; each fish can be cooked four or five ways, so ask for grilled or raw preparations; dishes have included tempura, Hatcho miso and soba (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kichizaemon_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood and game kappo, with dashi in the soups — a January 2026 diner praised the rich bonito dashi of the kasujiru.
kyoto_kichizaemon_gion.hours_raw: Tabelog: Monday–Saturday 18:00–22:30, closed Sunday; lunch by reservation at least a day ahead. Bookings online or by phone; same-day cancellations may incur a fee; seats-only bookings are cancelled 15 minutes after the time without notice (Tabelog). A 10% room charge for a private room used by four or fewer (Tabelog). 18 seats: 10 at the counter, 8 at tables; a tatami private room with a table for 4–8 looking onto the Kamo River (Tabelog; March 2024). Smoking allowed at dinner, not at lunch (Tabelog). Cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 2F of スペース新橋, by the Shirakawa bridge in front of a Seven-Eleven; 4 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; March 2024).
kyoto_kichizaemon_gion.notes: [Kappo · Gion Shirakawa, Wakasa fish your way] An 18-seat second-floor kappo by the Shirakawa, where the owner, from Wakasa, buys fish from Wakasa Bay and cooks each the way you choose from four or five methods: guji, fugu, Echizen crab, botan shrimp, with game such as boar and bear in season. Mostly à la carte from the menu and a blackboard, with a tatami room looking onto the Kamo River. About ¥10,000–15,000 a head at dinner (reviews). Smoking allowed at night. Mon–Sat from 18:00; lunch by booking.

roles: Owner-chef from Wakasa (named only in a machine-translated review)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s introduction: a casual kappo where the owner personally selects fresh seafood from Wakasa Bay, the owner’s hometown — Wakasa guji, fugu and Echizen crab — alongside wagyu, wild boar and duck, in a modern Japanese space with tables looking onto the Kamo River. A September 2025 regular of over ten years adds that the owner comes from a family that runs a restaurant in Wakasa and served for many years as second-in-command at a Kansai kaiseki restaurant in Osaka; that review names the owner, but only in English translation, so the name is not used here. A September 2026 diner found three people at work: the owner, a young assistant and a part-timer.
chef_bio.specialty: Wakasa seafood à la carte; fugu.

anecdotes.text: Asked "What would you like for your meal?", a regular of ten years answers "a little bit of everything that’s delicious" and has dishes brought at a comfortable pace — September 2025.
"They offer 4 to 5 cooking methods for each ingredient, allowing you to choose how you’d like it prepared." — July 2023.
A March 2024 diner liked being able to order à la carte and smoke at the table.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・ふぐ・海鮮、東山区弁財天町15 スペース新橋 2F、月〜土 18:00〜22:30、日曜休み、ランチは前日までの予約制、予約可 (当日キャンセルは料金あり、席のみの予約は15分の遅刻でキャンセル)、4名以下で個室利用の場合は個室料10%、18席 (カウンター10、テーブル8)、個室 (畳にテーブル、4〜8名)、喫煙可 (ランチのみ禁煙)、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、若狭湾の魚介 (若狭ぐじ、ふぐ、越前がに)、和牛・猪・鴨、鴨川の見えるテーブル席。口コミ (2023年7月〜2026年9月、英語): ほぼアラカルト、食材ごとに4〜5通りの調理法、越前の紅ずわい蟹、小浜のぼたん海老、しめ鯖、鯨、白子、熊肉、粕汁、八丁味噌のかぶら、黒板の日替わり、店主と若い助手とアルバイトの3人。

cultural_comfort.note: Mostly à la carte from a Japanese menu and blackboard, with the chef’s suggestions; book ahead.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (official information); reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_walden_woods.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; coffee and tea drinks with croissants, cream puffs, pudding and ice cream on a cookie base (2026 reviews).
kyoto_walden_woods.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee and Americano suit; lattes, ice cream, pudding and croissants use dairy, and plant milk is not mentioned (2026 reviews).
kyoto_walden_woods.hours_raw: Tabelog: every day 8:00–18:00; hours may change; an August 2026 review gives 8:30–18:00. No reservations. Order at the first-floor counter; the second floor is an all-white room with tiered benches and no tables or chairs, round a white tree (2026 reviews; Tabelog). Takeaway; children welcome; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards including UnionPay, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). No sign outside — a white building in a residential street (August 2026); 15 min walk from Gojo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_walden_woods.notes: [Coffee stand · Gojo, a white forest] A coffee and chai stand in an all-white, unsigned building on a residential street: order on the ground floor, then sit on the tiered white benches upstairs, round a single bare white tree, with no tables at all. Light-roast coffee and lattes (¥550–700), a ¥1,000 morning combo, pudding and cream puffs. Cafe WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews are mixed on the cappuccino and matcha ice cream, warm about the space. Daily 8:00–18:00.

roles: Coffee stand (operator not named on the sources read)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a white building with a first-floor counter round the kitchen and a second-floor room of tiered benches round a white tree, on the concept of living simply in harmony with nature after Walden (October 2026); the official site is titled "Coffee & Chai / Walden Woods Kyoto". Tabelog Cafe WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per an October 2026 review: "living simply in harmony with nature."
chef_bio.specialty: Light-roast coffee; chai latte.

anecdotes.text: "I stood in front of the entrance for quite a while, comparing it to the map and wondering, 'Is this really the right place?'" — August 2026.
An August 2026 morning visitor found the croissant good but the cappuccino disappointing.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (walden-woods.com): Coffee & Chai / Walden Woods Kyoto。食べログ: カフェ、下京区栄町508-1、毎日8:00〜18:00、予約不可、2階は立ち飲みかベンチ、テイクアウト、子供可、禁煙、カード可 (銀聯も)、電子マネー・QR 不可、カフェ WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): 白い森がテーマ、2階は白い木のまわりの段々のベンチ、看板がない、浅煎りのコーヒー、アメリカーノ550円、チャイラテ・抹茶ラテ700円、モーニングコンボ1,000円、プリン400円、シュークリーム300円、アイス500円。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter downstairs and take it up to the benches; no bookings.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026; Cafe WEST Tabelog 100 2025.

kyoto_ajanta_teramachi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; lunch sets come with naan (refills free) or rice, so rice is the choice to ask about, but how the curries are thickened is not described (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ajanta_teramachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and there are chickpea, lentil, okra, eggplant and spinach-potato curries, but butter, cream and paneer appear in others, and the use of ghee is not stated (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ajanta_teramachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: every day 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00. Bookings taken; private hire for 20 to over 50 (Tabelog). Lunch sets with salad, a spiced carrot-and-tomato soup, a drink and free naan or rice refills — ¥1,100 (August 2025), special lunch ¥1,450 (March 2026), C lunch about ¥1,000 including a glass of wine (February 2026); about 25 curries to choose from at lunch (July 2026). 63 seats over two floors (28 and 35); non-smoking; children welcome; takeaway (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay, no e-money (Tabelog). On Teramachi south of Takatsuji, 1F of the 山本ビル; 5 min walk south from Hankyu Kawaramachi’s Fujii Daimaru exit (Tabelog).
kyoto_ajanta_teramachi.notes: [Indian curry · Teramachi-Takatsuji, a long-time naan house] A two-floor, 63-seat Indian curry house on Teramachi that one regular has visited for about 20 years: lunch sets around ¥1,000–1,450 with spiced carrot soup, salad, a drink and free naan refills, a choice of some 25 curries (butter chicken is the favourite), tandoori chicken and big biryani. Curry WEST Tabelog 100 2020. Vegetarian curries available. Open daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00.

roles: Chef (unnamed) with over 15 years at a five-star hotel in India, per Tabelog
chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s introduction: authentic Indian food by a chef with more than 15 years at a five-star hotel in India, with herbs, spices and other ingredients imported directly from India, and over 60 seats on two floors. A March 2026 regular has come for about 20 years, when this and Ashoka were among the few places for authentic naan and curry in Kyoto. A February 2026 diner found the staff answered in broken Japanese, attentively. Tabelog Curry WEST "Tabelog 100" 2020.
chef_bio.specialty: Butter chicken curry; free naan refills.

anecdotes.text: "If you tend to sweat while eating, a towel is a must!" — June 2026.
A September 2025 diner found the okra curry bitter and the chicken biryani far too big to finish, and suggests a half size.
"I was thrilled to see that there were 25 different types of curry to choose from for lunch." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: インド料理・インドカレー、下京区寺町通高辻下ル京極町515-4 山本ビル 1F、毎日11:00〜15:00・17:00〜22:00、予約可、63席 (1階28、2階35)、貸切20〜50名以上、禁煙、子供可、テイクアウト、カード・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、ベジタリアンメニューあり、インドの五つ星ホテルで15年以上の経験のシェフ、ハーブやスパイスをインドから直輸入、カレー WEST 百名店 2020。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年7月、英語): ランチ1,100円・スペシャルランチ1,450円・C ランチ約1,000円 (グラスワイン付き)、ナンのおかわり無料、にんじんとトマトのスパイススープ、カレー25種、バターチキン、ほうれん草とマトン、キーマ、ひよこ豆、レンズ豆、タンドリーチキン、ビリヤニ、20年来の客。

cultural_comfort.note: Pick a curry and naan or rice from the lunch sets; staff speak some Japanese (February 2026).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.
